ngsl12:difficult.exampleEnglish: Although the instructions looked difficult at first, we understood them once the teacher gave an example.
ngsl12:difficult.exampleChinese: 虽然说明起初看起来很难，但老师举了一个例子后，我们就理解了。

ngsl12:please.exampleEnglish: Could you please check the address before we leave, so that we do not get lost?
ngsl12:please.exampleChinese: 出发前你能检查一下地址吗，这样我们就不会迷路了？

ngsl12:detail.exampleEnglish: The guide explained every detail of the route before our group began the mountain walk.
ngsl12:detail.exampleChinese: 我们的团队开始登山前，向导解释了路线的每一个细节。

ngsl12:difference.exampleEnglish: The main difference between the two courses is that one includes more opportunities to practise speaking.
ngsl12:difference.exampleChinese: 这两门课程的主要区别是，其中一门提供了更多练习口语的机会。

ngsl12:action.exampleEnglish: After several complaints about the broken gate, the school finally took action to repair it.
ngsl12:action.exampleChinese: 在收到几次关于大门损坏的投诉后，学校终于采取了修理行动。

ngsl12:health.exampleEnglish: Regular breaks can benefit your health, especially if your job involves sitting at a desk all day.
ngsl12:health.exampleChinese: 经常休息对健康有益，尤其是当你的工作需要整天坐在办公桌前时。

ngsl12:eat.exampleEnglish: We usually eat together in the evening, even when everyone has had a particularly busy day.
ngsl12:eat.exampleChinese: 我们通常晚上一起吃饭，即使大家当天都特别忙。

ngsl12:step.exampleEnglish: The lowest step was covered in wet leaves, so I held the rail as I went down.
ngsl12:step.exampleChinese: 最下面一级台阶盖着湿树叶，所以我下楼时扶着栏杆。

ngsl12:true.exampleEnglish: The story sounded unlikely, but several people who were there confirmed that it was true.
ngsl12:true.exampleChinese: 这个故事听起来不太可信，但几位当时在场的人证实了它是真的。

ngsl12:phone.exampleEnglish: Please phone the hotel before we arrive to ask whether our room will be ready early.
ngsl12:phone.exampleChinese: 请在我们到达前给酒店打电话，问问房间能否提前准备好。

ngsl12:themselves.exampleEnglish: The children prepared the picnic themselves, although their parents helped them carry everything to the park.
ngsl12:themselves.exampleChinese: 孩子们自己准备了野餐，不过父母帮他们把所有东西搬到了公园。

ngsl12:draw.exampleEnglish: Our teacher asked us to draw a building that we could see from the classroom window.
ngsl12:draw.exampleChinese: 老师让我们画一栋从教室窗户能看到的建筑。

ngsl12:white.exampleEnglish: She chose white curtains because they made the small bedroom look brighter during the winter months.
ngsl12:white.exampleChinese: 她选了白色窗帘，因为它们让小卧室在冬季看起来更明亮。

ngsl12:date.exampleEnglish: We agreed on a date for the meeting after checking when everyone would be available.
ngsl12:date.exampleChinese: 查看了大家什么时候有空之后，我们商定了会议日期。

ngsl12:practice.exampleEnglish: If you practice giving short talks regularly, you may feel more comfortable speaking in front of others.
ngsl12:practice.exampleChinese: 如果经常练习做简短演讲，你在别人面前说话时可能会更自在。

ngsl12:model.exampleEnglish: The students built a model of their town to show how the new bridge would look.
ngsl12:model.exampleChinese: 学生们制作了一个城镇模型，展示新桥建成后的样子。

ngsl12:raise.exampleEnglish: The cafe plans to raise its prices slightly because the cost of ingredients has increased.
ngsl12:raise.exampleChinese: 由于原料成本上涨，这家咖啡馆计划略微提价。

ngsl12:customer.exampleEnglish: A customer who had left her bag in the shop returned just before we closed.
ngsl12:customer.exampleChinese: 一位把包落在店里的顾客在我们关门前赶了回来。

ngsl12:front.exampleEnglish: Please use the front entrance, as the door at the back is being repaired today.
ngsl12:front.exampleChinese: 请走前门，因为后门今天正在维修。

ngsl12:explain.exampleEnglish: Could you explain how this machine works before I try using it for the first time?
ngsl12:explain.exampleChinese: 在我第一次尝试使用这台机器前，你能解释一下它如何运作吗？

ngsl12:door.exampleEnglish: I left a note on the door so that visitors would know where to find us.
ngsl12:door.exampleChinese: 我在门上留了一张便条，好让访客知道去哪里找我们。

ngsl12:outside.exampleEnglish: The outside of the house needs painting, but the rooms inside are still in good condition.
ngsl12:outside.exampleChinese: 房子的外部需要粉刷，但里面的房间状况仍然很好。

ngsl12:behind.exampleEnglish: We had almost reached the station when I noticed that my younger brother had fallen behind.
ngsl12:behind.exampleChinese: 我们快到车站时，我才注意到弟弟落在了后面。

ngsl12:economic.exampleEnglish: The report describes the economic changes that have affected small businesses over the past five years.
ngsl12:economic.exampleChinese: 这份报告描述了过去五年影响小企业的经济变化。

ngsl12:site.exampleEnglish: Before the builders arrived, experts visited the site to check whether the ground was suitable.
ngsl12:site.exampleChinese: 建筑工人到来之前，专家去了工地，检查地面是否合适。

ngsl12:approach.exampleEnglish: As we approach the village, you will see an old stone bridge on the left.
ngsl12:approach.exampleChinese: 当我们接近村庄时，你会在左边看到一座古老的石桥。

ngsl12:teacher.exampleEnglish: Our science teacher encouraged us to test our ideas instead of simply accepting the answers.
ngsl12:teacher.exampleChinese: 科学老师鼓励我们检验自己的想法，而不是简单地接受答案。

ngsl12:land.exampleEnglish: The farmer bought the land beside the river because it was suitable for growing vegetables.
ngsl12:land.exampleChinese: 这位农民买下了河边的土地，因为那里适合种蔬菜。

ngsl12:charge.exampleEnglish: Some museums charge visitors an entrance fee, while others allow everyone to enter free of charge.
ngsl12:charge.exampleChinese: 有些博物馆向参观者收取门票费，而另一些允许所有人免费入内。

collocations.chinese: 向某人收取某物的费用

ngsl12:finally.exampleEnglish: After trying several different routes, we finally found a quiet path that led to the beach.
ngsl12:finally.exampleChinese: 尝试了几条不同的路线后，我们终于找到了一条通往海滩的安静小路。

ngsl12:sign.exampleEnglish: The first sign of trouble was a strange noise coming from the back of the car.
ngsl12:sign.exampleChinese: 出现问题的第一个迹象是汽车后部传来奇怪的响声。

ngsl12:claim.exampleEnglish: The makers claim that this bag is waterproof, although we have not tested it in heavy rain.
ngsl12:claim.exampleChinese: 制造商声称这个包防水，不过我们还没有在大雨中测试过。

ngsl12:relationship.exampleEnglish: Their relationship improved after they began discussing problems calmly instead of blaming each other for mistakes.
ngsl12:relationship.exampleChinese: 他们开始冷静地讨论问题，而不是因错误互相指责之后，关系改善了。

ngsl12:travel.exampleEnglish: We prefer to travel by train when possible because it gives us time to enjoy the scenery.
ngsl12:travel.exampleChinese: 只要可能，我们更喜欢乘火车旅行，因为这样有时间欣赏风景。

ngsl12:enjoy.exampleEnglish: The children seemed to enjoy the museum visit more once they could try the activities themselves.
ngsl12:enjoy.exampleChinese: 孩子们能亲自动手尝试活动后，似乎更喜欢这次博物馆参观了。

ngsl12:death.exampleEnglish: The writer's death was announced yesterday, and readers shared memories of how her books had inspired them.
ngsl12:death.exampleChinese: 这位作家去世的消息昨天公布了，读者纷纷分享她的书如何启发自己的回忆。

ngsl12:nice.exampleEnglish: It was nice to meet the neighbours properly after living next door to them for several months.
ngsl12:nice.exampleChinese: 和邻居做了几个月的邻居后，能正式认识他们真令人高兴。

ngsl12:amount.exampleEnglish: The amount of water we use each day depends partly on how long we spend showering.
ngsl12:amount.exampleChinese: 我们每天的用水量部分取决于淋浴时间有多长。

ngsl12:improve.exampleEnglish: You can improve your listening skills by following short recordings and checking the words you miss.
ngsl12:improve.exampleChinese: 你可以跟着短录音听，并核对漏听的单词，来提高听力。

ngsl12:picture.exampleEnglish: The picture on the website looked different from the room we were actually given at the hotel.
ngsl12:picture.exampleChinese: 网站上的照片与酒店实际给我们的房间看起来不同。

ngsl12:boy.exampleEnglish: The boy who found the missing dog waited outside the library until its owner arrived.
ngsl12:boy.exampleChinese: 找到那只走失狗的男孩在图书馆外等着，直到狗主人到来。

ngsl12:regard.exampleEnglish: We regard safety as our first concern whenever we organize an activity for younger children outdoors.
ngsl12:regard.exampleChinese: 每当为年幼的孩子组织户外活动时，我们都把安全视为首要考虑。

collocations.chinese: 以尊重的态度看待某人

ngsl12:organization.exampleEnglish: The organization provides free books to families who cannot easily reach a library in their area.
ngsl12:organization.exampleChinese: 这个组织为无法方便地前往当地图书馆的家庭提供免费图书。

ngsl12:happy.exampleEnglish: She was happy with the final design, even though it was quite different from her original idea.
ngsl12:happy.exampleChinese: 她对最终设计很满意，尽管它与最初的想法很不一样。

ngsl12:couple.exampleEnglish: A couple who live near the station offered us directions when they saw us studying the map.
ngsl12:couple.exampleChinese: 住在车站附近的一对夫妇看见我们研究地图，主动给我们指路。

ngsl12:act.exampleEnglish: Try to act calmly if the plan changes, because the rest of the group will follow your example.
ngsl12:act.exampleChinese: 如果计划改变，尽量保持冷静，因为团队其他人会以你为榜样。

ngsl12:range.exampleEnglish: The shop offers a wide range of equipment, from simple tools to machines for professional use.
ngsl12:range.exampleChinese: 这家商店提供种类丰富的设备，从简单工具到专业机器应有尽有。

ngsl12:quality.exampleEnglish: The quality of the recording improved considerably after we moved the microphone closer to the speaker.
ngsl12:quality.exampleChinese: 我们把麦克风移近说话的人之后，录音质量明显改善了。

ngsl12:project.exampleEnglish: Our class started a project to discover how much food the school throws away each week.
ngsl12:project.exampleChinese: 我们班开展了一个项目，调查学校每周丢弃多少食物。

ngsl12:round.exampleEnglish: We sat at a round table so that everyone could see and hear each other easily.
ngsl12:round.exampleChinese: 我们坐在一张圆桌旁，这样大家都能轻松看到和听到彼此。

ngsl12:opportunity.exampleEnglish: The exchange programme gave her an opportunity to practise English with people from several different countries.
ngsl12:opportunity.exampleChinese: 这个交流项目给了她与来自几个不同国家的人练习英语的机会。

ngsl12:road.exampleEnglish: The road to the village was closed after heavy rain, so we had to choose another route.
ngsl12:road.exampleChinese: 大雨过后，通往村庄的道路被封闭了，所以我们不得不另选路线。

ngsl12:accord.exampleEnglish: The two towns signed an accord to share public transport services and reduce the cost of travel.
ngsl12:accord.exampleChinese: 这两个城镇签署了协议，共享公共交通服务并降低出行成本。

ngsl12:list.exampleEnglish: Before we went shopping, I made a list of everything we needed for the weekend trip.
ngsl12:list.exampleChinese: 购物之前，我列出了周末旅行所需所有物品的清单。

ngsl12:wish.exampleEnglish: I wish I had asked more questions when my grandparents told me stories about their childhood.
ngsl12:wish.exampleChinese: 祖父母给我讲童年故事时，我真希望自己当时多问一些问题。

ngsl12:therefore.exampleEnglish: The bridge is closed for repairs; therefore, all buses must take a longer route through the town.
ngsl12:therefore.exampleChinese: 这座桥因维修而关闭；因此，所有公交车都必须走穿过城镇的较长路线。

ngsl12:wear.exampleEnglish: You should wear comfortable shoes because the tour includes a long walk through the old town.
ngsl12:wear.exampleChinese: 你应该穿舒适的鞋，因为行程包括长时间步行穿过老城区。

ngsl12:fund.exampleEnglish: The school created a fund to help students who could not afford to join the trip.
ngsl12:fund.exampleChinese: 学校设立了一项基金，帮助无力支付费用参加旅行的学生。

ngsl12:rest.exampleEnglish: After carrying the boxes upstairs, we needed a short rest before starting to unpack them carefully.
ngsl12:rest.exampleChinese: 把箱子搬上楼后，我们需要稍作休息，再开始小心地拆箱。

ngsl12:kid.exampleEnglish: Every kid in the group was given a small task so that nobody felt left out.
ngsl12:kid.exampleChinese: 小组里的每个孩子都分到了一项小任务，这样就没有人觉得被冷落。

ngsl12:industry.exampleEnglish: The fishing industry provides many jobs in the town, although tourism is becoming increasingly important too.
ngsl12:industry.exampleChinese: 渔业为这个城镇提供了许多工作，尽管旅游业也变得日益重要。

ngsl12:education.exampleEnglish: Access to a good education can give young people more choices when they begin their working lives.
ngsl12:education.exampleChinese: 获得良好教育能让年轻人在开始工作生涯时拥有更多选择。

ngsl12:measure.exampleEnglish: Please measure the window carefully before ordering curtains, since the old ones were much too short.
ngsl12:measure.exampleChinese: 订购窗帘前，请仔细测量窗户，因为旧窗帘实在太短了。

ngsl12:kill.exampleEnglish: The sudden frost can kill young plants, so the gardener covers them when cold nights are expected.
ngsl12:kill.exampleChinese: 突如其来的霜冻会使幼苗死亡，所以预计夜晚寒冷时，园丁会盖住它们。

ngsl12:serve.exampleEnglish: The volunteers serve warm meals to visitors who have spent the whole morning walking in the cold.
ngsl12:serve.exampleChinese: 志愿者为整个上午都在寒冷中行走的访客提供热饭。

ngsl12:likely.exampleEnglish: The train is likely to be crowded because several large events are taking place this weekend.
ngsl12:likely.exampleChinese: 火车很可能很拥挤，因为本周末会举行几场大型活动。

ngsl12:certainly.exampleEnglish: We certainly enjoyed the concert, although the journey home took much longer than we had expected.
ngsl12:certainly.exampleChinese: 我们确实很喜欢这场音乐会，尽管回家花的时间比预想长得多。

ngsl12:national.exampleEnglish: The painting will remain in the national museum until the exhibition moves to another city next spring.
ngsl12:national.exampleChinese: 这幅画将留在国家博物馆，直到展览明年春天移至另一座城市。

ngsl12:itself.exampleEnglish: The machine switches itself off when the water reaches the right temperature, which helps save energy.
ngsl12:itself.exampleChinese: 水达到适当温度时，这台机器会自动关闭，这有助于节能。

ngsl12:teach.exampleEnglish: My grandfather used to teach us how to repair simple tools rather than immediately buying new ones.
ngsl12:teach.exampleChinese: 祖父过去常教我们如何修理简单工具，而不是马上买新的。

ngsl12:field.exampleEnglish: We crossed a field of yellow flowers before reaching the narrow path that led towards the lake.
ngsl12:field.exampleChinese: 我们穿过一片开着黄花的田野，才到达通往湖边的狭窄小路。

ngsl12:security.exampleEnglish: Airport security was unusually busy that morning, so we arrived earlier to allow enough time for checks.
ngsl12:security.exampleChinese: 那天早晨机场安检异常繁忙，所以我们提早到达，留出足够的检查时间。

ngsl12:air.exampleEnglish: Fresh air came through the open windows while we waited for the afternoon meeting to begin.
ngsl12:air.exampleChinese: 我们等待下午会议开始时，新鲜空气从敞开的窗户吹了进来。

ngsl12:benefit.exampleEnglish: One benefit of joining the club is that you can learn from people with more experience.
ngsl12:benefit.exampleChinese: 加入这个俱乐部的一个好处是，你可以向经验更丰富的人学习。

ngsl12:trade.exampleEnglish: The two villages used to trade goods at a weekly market before a road connected them.
ngsl12:trade.exampleChinese: 在一条道路将它们连接起来之前，这两个村庄过去每周在集市交易货物。

ngsl12:risk.exampleEnglish: We decided not to risk missing the last train, even though the concert had not finished.
ngsl12:risk.exampleChinese: 尽管音乐会还没有结束，我们还是决定不冒错过末班火车的风险。

ngsl12:news.exampleEnglish: The news about the new library pleased residents who had campaigned for better local services for years.
ngsl12:news.exampleChinese: 有关新图书馆的消息让多年来争取改善当地服务的居民感到高兴。

ngsl12:standard.exampleEnglish: The room includes all the standard equipment, but you must request a projector before the meeting.
ngsl12:standard.exampleChinese: 房间包括所有标准设备，但你必须在会议前申请投影仪。

ngsl12:vote.exampleEnglish: Club members will vote on the proposal after everyone has had a chance to ask questions.
ngsl12:vote.exampleChinese: 待每个人都有机会提问后，俱乐部成员将对这个提议进行投票。

ngsl12:percent.exampleEnglish: Almost twenty percent of the students cycle to school, according to the survey we completed last month.
ngsl12:percent.exampleChinese: 根据我们上个月完成的调查，将近百分之二十的学生骑车上学。

ngsl12:focus.exampleEnglish: The main focus of our discussion was how to make the school garden easier to maintain.
ngsl12:focus.exampleChinese: 我们讨论的重点是如何让学校花园更容易维护。

ngsl12:stage.exampleEnglish: The musicians waited behind the stage until the audience had taken their seats and the lights dimmed.
ngsl12:stage.exampleChinese: 音乐家们在舞台后等待，直到观众就座、灯光暗下。

ngsl12:space.exampleEnglish: We moved the desk beside the window to create more space in the middle of the room.
ngsl12:space.exampleChinese: 我们把书桌移到窗边，以便在房间中央腾出更多空间。

ngsl12:instead.exampleEnglish: The weather was too wet for a picnic, so we invited everyone to our house instead.
ngsl12:instead.exampleChinese: 天气太湿，不适合野餐，所以我们改为邀请大家到我们家来。

ngsl12:realize.exampleEnglish: I did not realize how much the town had changed until I visited my old school.
ngsl12:realize.exampleChinese: 直到参观了母校，我才意识到这个城镇变化有多大。

ngsl12:usually.exampleEnglish: We usually buy our vegetables at the market, although we sometimes use the supermarket when it rains.
ngsl12:usually.exampleChinese: 我们通常在市场买蔬菜，不过下雨时有时会去超市。

ngsl12:data.exampleEnglish: The team collected data from several schools before deciding which changes might improve students' learning experiences.
ngsl12:data.exampleChinese: 团队在决定哪些改变可能改善学生的学习体验之前，收集了几所学校的数据。

ngsl12:single.exampleEnglish: There was not a single empty seat when we entered the hall just before the performance.
ngsl12:single.exampleChinese: 演出开始前，我们进入大厅时，一个空座位也没有。

ngsl12:address.exampleEnglish: Please write your full address clearly so that the parcel can be delivered without any delay.
ngsl12:address.exampleChinese: 请清楚地写下完整地址，以便包裹能毫无延误地送达。

ngsl12:performance.exampleEnglish: Her performance was particularly impressive because she had only learned the difficult piece a few weeks earlier.
ngsl12:performance.exampleChinese: 她的演出特别精彩，因为她仅在几周前才学会这首难曲。

ngsl12:chance.exampleEnglish: There is a good chance that we will finish early if everyone brings the materials we need.
ngsl12:chance.exampleChinese: 如果每个人都带齐所需材料，我们很有可能提前完成。

ngsl12:accept.exampleEnglish: She decided to accept the offer after considering how the new role would affect her family.
ngsl12:accept.exampleChinese: 考虑了新职位对家庭的影响后，她决定接受这个录用邀请。

ngsl12:society.exampleEnglish: Public libraries play an important role in society by giving people free access to information and ideas.
ngsl12:society.exampleChinese: 公共图书馆让人们免费获取信息和思想，在社会中发挥着重要作用。

ngsl12:technology.exampleEnglish: New technology allows us to share documents instantly, even when our colleagues are working in different countries.
ngsl12:technology.exampleChinese: 新技术让我们能够即时分享文件，即使同事们正在不同国家工作。

ngsl12:mention.exampleEnglish: Please mention any food allergies when you book, so that the restaurant can prepare a suitable meal.
ngsl12:mention.exampleChinese: 预订时请说明是否有食物过敏，以便餐馆准备合适的饭菜。

ngsl12:choice.exampleEnglish: We had a choice between taking the early bus and paying more for a direct train.
ngsl12:choice.exampleChinese: 我们可以选择乘早班公交车，或多花钱坐直达火车。

ngsl12:save.exampleEnglish: The quick response of the volunteers helped save several animals that had become trapped by the flood.
ngsl12:save.exampleChinese: 志愿者的迅速反应帮助救出了几只被洪水困住的动物。

ngsl12:common.exampleEnglish: It is common for visitors to get lost here because several streets have very similar names.
ngsl12:common.exampleChinese: 游客在这里迷路很常见，因为几条街道的名字十分相似。

ngsl12:culture.exampleEnglish: Learning about another culture can help us understand why people communicate and celebrate in different ways.
ngsl12:culture.exampleChinese: 了解另一种文化可以帮助我们理解，人们为什么以不同方式交流和庆祝。

ngsl12:total.exampleEnglish: The total includes breakfast and transport, so you will not need to pay extra for those services.
ngsl12:total.exampleChinese: 总价包括早餐和交通，所以你不必为这些服务额外付费。

ngsl12:demand.exampleEnglish: Residents demand better lighting along the path because several people have fallen there after dark this winter.
ngsl12:demand.exampleChinese: 居民强烈要求改善小路的照明，因为今年冬天已有几人在天黑后在那里摔倒。

ngsl12:material.exampleEnglish: The designer chose a light material that would keep the jacket comfortable even in warm weather.
ngsl12:material.exampleChinese: 设计师选了一种轻薄材料，让夹克即使在暖和天气里穿着也舒适。

ngsl12:limit.exampleEnglish: There is a limit to how many visitors the island can welcome without damaging its natural environment.
ngsl12:limit.exampleChinese: 在不破坏自然环境的前提下，这座岛能接待的游客数量是有限的。

ngsl12:listen.exampleEnglish: If you listen carefully to the instructions, you will find the activity much easier to complete.
ngsl12:listen.exampleChinese: 如果仔细听说明，你会发现完成这项活动容易得多。

ngsl12:due.exampleEnglish: The final report is due on Friday, so we need to check all the figures before then.
ngsl12:due.exampleChinese: 最终报告周五到期，所以我们需要在那之前核对所有数字。

ngsl12:wrong.exampleEnglish: We took the wrong turning after the bridge, which added another twenty minutes to our journey.
ngsl12:wrong.exampleChinese: 过桥后我们拐错了弯，这使行程又增加了二十分钟。

ngsl12:foot.exampleEnglish: She hurt her foot during the walk, so we stopped at a cafe while she rested.
ngsl12:foot.exampleChinese: 她步行时伤了脚，所以我们停在咖啡馆，让她休息。

ngsl12:effort.exampleEnglish: The whole team made an effort to finish the display before the first visitors arrived that morning.
ngsl12:effort.exampleChinese: 整个团队努力赶在那天早晨首批访客到来前完成展品布置。

ngsl12:attention.exampleEnglish: The guide asked for our attention before explaining which parts of the castle were open to visitors.
ngsl12:attention.exampleChinese: 导游请大家注意听，然后解释城堡哪些部分对游客开放。

ngsl12:upon.exampleEnglish: Upon entering the room, we noticed a handwritten message resting upon the table beside the window.
ngsl12:upon.exampleChinese: 一进房间，我们就注意到窗边桌子上放着一张手写便条。

ngsl12:check.exampleEnglish: We should check whether the tickets include luggage before we decide which train service to book.
ngsl12:check.exampleChinese: 在决定预订哪班火车前，我们应该核实票价是否包含行李费用。

ngsl12:complete.exampleEnglish: The students worked in pairs to complete the experiment before comparing their results with another group.
ngsl12:complete.exampleChinese: 学生们两人一组完成实验，然后与另一组比较结果。

ngsl12:lie.exampleEnglish: He decided not to lie about the broken window because he knew someone else might be blamed.
ngsl12:lie.exampleChinese: 他决定不为打破窗户的事撒谎，因为他知道别人可能会受到责怪。

ngsl12:pick.exampleEnglish: You can pick a topic that interests you, provided there is enough information available for your research.
ngsl12:pick.exampleChinese: 你可以选择自己感兴趣的话题，前提是有足够的信息可用于研究。

ngsl12:reduce.exampleEnglish: We hope to reduce food waste by planning meals carefully and using ingredients that are already available.
ngsl12:reduce.exampleChinese: 我们希望通过仔细安排餐食并利用现有食材来减少食物浪费。

ngsl12:personal.exampleEnglish: She prefers to keep her personal photographs off public websites, although she shares them with close friends.
ngsl12:personal.exampleChinese: 她倾向于不把私人照片放到公开网站上，不过会与好友分享。

ngsl12:ground.exampleEnglish: The ground was still wet from the overnight rain, so we spread a waterproof sheet beneath the picnic blanket.
ngsl12:ground.exampleChinese: 夜雨过后地面仍然湿着，所以我们在野餐毯下面铺了一张防水布。

ngsl12:animal.exampleEnglish: The guide reminded us not to approach any animal that appeared nervous or was protecting its young.
ngsl12:animal.exampleChinese: 导游提醒我们，不要靠近显得紧张或正在保护幼崽的动物。

ngsl12:arrive.exampleEnglish: If we arrive before the museum opens, we can have breakfast at the cafe across the road.
ngsl12:arrive.exampleChinese: 如果在博物馆开门前到达，我们可以在马路对面的咖啡馆吃早餐。

ngsl12:patient.exampleEnglish: Our instructor remained patient while we practised the difficult movement, even though we kept making mistakes.
ngsl12:patient.exampleChinese: 我们练习那个困难动作时，教练一直很有耐心，尽管我们总是犯错。

ngsl12:current.exampleEnglish: The current timetable leaves little time for discussion, so we are considering making each session longer.
ngsl12:current.exampleChinese: 目前的时间表几乎没有留讨论时间，所以我们正考虑延长每场活动。

ngsl12:century.exampleEnglish: The bridge was built over a century ago, yet it still carries traffic through the town every day.
ngsl12:century.exampleChinese: 这座桥建于一个多世纪以前，但每天仍有车辆从桥上穿城而过。

ngsl12:evidence.exampleEnglish: The team needed more evidence before they could explain why the river water had changed colour.
ngsl12:evidence.exampleChinese: 团队需要更多证据，才能解释河水为什么变了颜色。

ngsl12:exist.exampleEnglish: Some traditional skills still exist in this village because older residents continue to teach them to children.
ngsl12:exist.exampleChinese: 这个村庄仍保留着一些传统技艺，因为年长居民一直把它们传授给孩子。

ngsl12:similar.exampleEnglish: The two paintings look similar from a distance, but their colours are quite different when viewed closely.
ngsl12:similar.exampleChinese: 远看这两幅画像很相似，但近看时，它们的颜色差别很大。

ngsl12:fight.exampleEnglish: A fight broke out after the match, but the players quickly helped the coach calm everyone down.
ngsl12:fight.exampleChinese: 比赛后发生了一场打斗，但队员们很快帮助教练让所有人冷静下来。

ngsl12:leader.exampleEnglish: A good leader listens to different opinions before deciding how the group should deal with a problem.
ngsl12:leader.exampleChinese: 优秀的领导者会先听取不同意见，再决定团队该如何处理问题。

ngsl12:fine.exampleEnglish: The room was small but perfectly fine for our needs, since we spent most of the day outside.
ngsl12:fine.exampleChinese: 房间虽小，但完全能满足需求，因为我们一天大部分时间都在外面。

ngsl12:street.exampleEnglish: The street becomes quieter in the evening, when the market stalls close and most visitors leave.
ngsl12:street.exampleChinese: 到了晚上，市场摊位关闭、大多数游客离开时，这条街就安静下来。

ngsl12:former.exampleEnglish: A former teacher returned to the school to describe how the neighbourhood had changed over the years.
ngsl12:former.exampleChinese: 一位前任教师回到学校，讲述这个社区多年来如何变化。

ngsl12:contact.exampleEnglish: Please contact the organiser if your plans change, so that your place can be offered to someone else.
ngsl12:contact.exampleChinese: 如果计划有变，请联系组织者，以便把你的名额让给别人。

ngsl12:particularly.exampleEnglish: The path is particularly beautiful in autumn, when the leaves turn gold and fewer visitors are around.
ngsl12:particularly.exampleChinese: 秋天树叶变成金色、游客减少时，这条小路尤其美丽。

ngsl12:wife.exampleEnglish: His wife suggested taking the earlier train because it would give them more time to explore the city.
ngsl12:wife.exampleChinese: 他的妻子建议坐更早的火车，因为这样能给他们更多时间探索城市。

ngsl12:sport.exampleEnglish: Trying a new sport can be a good way to meet people, even if you are not competitive.
ngsl12:sport.exampleChinese: 尝试一项新运动可以是结识朋友的好方法，即使你并不好胜。

ngsl12:prepare.exampleEnglish: We need to prepare a few questions before the interview so that we can use the time well.
ngsl12:prepare.exampleChinese: 面试前我们需要准备几个问题，以便充分利用时间。

ngsl12:discuss.exampleEnglish: The committee will discuss the proposal next week, after members have had time to read the full report.
ngsl12:discuss.exampleChinese: 委员们有时间阅读完整报告之后，委员会将于下周讨论这个提案。

ngsl12:response.exampleEnglish: We have not received a response to our invitation, although the event is now less than a week away.
ngsl12:response.exampleChinese: 虽然距离活动已不到一周，我们仍未收到邀请的回复。

ngsl12:voice.exampleEnglish: She lowered her voice when she entered the library, where several students were preparing for an exam.
ngsl12:voice.exampleChinese: 她进入图书馆时压低了声音，那里有几名学生正在准备考试。

ngsl12:piece.exampleEnglish: Each student chose a piece of coloured paper and folded it into a shape of their own design.
ngsl12:piece.exampleChinese: 每个学生选了一张彩纸，把它折成自己设计的形状。

ngsl12:finish.exampleEnglish: The race had a surprising finish, as the youngest runner passed two experienced competitors near the end.
ngsl12:finish.exampleChinese: 这场比赛的结局出人意料，最年轻的选手在接近终点时超过了两名经验丰富的对手。

ngsl12:suppose.exampleEnglish: I suppose we could move the meeting online if the weather prevents people from travelling safely.
ngsl12:suppose.exampleChinese: 如果天气使大家无法安全出行，我想我们可以把会议改为在线举行。

ngsl12:apply.exampleEnglish: She decided to apply for the training course after discovering that it included several practical workshops.
ngsl12:apply.exampleChinese: 得知培训课程包含几场实践工作坊后，她决定申请参加。

ngsl12:president.exampleEnglish: The club president welcomed the new members before explaining how they could take part in future events.
ngsl12:president.exampleChinese: 俱乐部会长先欢迎新成员，然后解释他们可以如何参加今后的活动。

ngsl12:fire.exampleEnglish: We kept the fire small because there was little dry wood left after the rainstorm.
ngsl12:fire.exampleChinese: 暴雨过后剩下的干木头不多了，所以我们把火控制得很小。

ngsl12:compare.exampleEnglish: Before buying a new laptop, compare the features that matter most to the work you actually do.
ngsl12:compare.exampleChinese: 购买新笔记本电脑之前，比较一下对你实际工作最重要的那些功能。

ngsl12:court.exampleEnglish: The basketball court behind the school is open to local families when lessons have finished for the day.
ngsl12:court.exampleChinese: 学校后面的篮球场在当天课程结束后向当地家庭开放。

ngsl12:police.exampleEnglish: The police asked anyone who had seen the missing bicycle to contact the local station directly.
ngsl12:police.exampleChinese: 警方请所有见过那辆丢失自行车的人直接联系当地警察局。

ngsl12:store.exampleEnglish: The store stays open later on Fridays so that people can shop after they finish work.
ngsl12:store.exampleChinese: 这家商店周五营业到更晚，方便人们下班后购物。

ngsl12:poor.exampleEnglish: The charity works with poor families who need help buying school clothes and other essential items.
ngsl12:poor.exampleChinese: 这家慈善机构帮助需要资助购买校服等必需品的贫困家庭。

ngsl12:knowledge.exampleEnglish: Her knowledge of local history made the walk more interesting than simply following a map would have been.
ngsl12:knowledge.exampleChinese: 她对当地历史的了解，让这次步行比单纯照着地图走更有趣。

ngsl12:laugh.exampleEnglish: We could not help but laugh when the dog proudly carried our empty picnic basket back home.
ngsl12:laugh.exampleChinese: 狗得意地提着空野餐篮回家时，我们都忍不住笑了。

ngsl12:arm.exampleEnglish: She carried the books under one arm while using her other hand to open the classroom door.
ngsl12:arm.exampleChinese: 她一只胳膊夹着书，另一只手用来打开教室门。

ngsl12:heart.exampleEnglish: During the science lesson, we learned how the heart pumps blood around the body throughout the day.
ngsl12:heart.exampleChinese: 科学课上，我们学习了心脏如何全天将血液泵送到全身。

ngsl12:source.exampleEnglish: The village well used to be the main source of drinking water before pipes reached every house.
ngsl12:source.exampleChinese: 在管道通到每家每户之前，村里的水井曾是主要饮用水来源。

ngsl12:employee.exampleEnglish: Every new employee attends a short course that explains the company's safety rules and working procedures.
ngsl12:employee.exampleChinese: 每位新员工都会参加一门短期课程，了解公司的安全规则和工作流程。

ngsl12:manage.exampleEnglish: She learned to manage the cafe by working alongside her aunt, who had run it for years.
ngsl12:manage.exampleChinese: 她与经营咖啡馆多年的姑姑一起工作，从而学会了如何管理咖啡馆。

ngsl12:simply.exampleEnglish: The instructions explain the process simply, so you do not need any previous experience to follow them.
ngsl12:simply.exampleChinese: 说明用简单的方式解释了流程，所以无需任何经验也能照着操作。

ngsl12:bank.exampleEnglish: We went to the bank to ask which account would be suitable for saving money regularly.
ngsl12:bank.exampleChinese: 我们去银行询问哪种账户适合定期储蓄。

ngsl12:firm.exampleEnglish: The mattress was too firm for my sister, so the hotel offered her a softer one.
ngsl12:firm.exampleChinese: 床垫对我姐姐来说太硬了，所以酒店给她换了一张更软的。

ngsl12:cell.exampleEnglish: My cell phone had no signal inside the building, so I stepped outside to call the driver.
ngsl12:cell.exampleChinese: 我的手机在楼里没有信号，所以我走到外面给司机打电话。

ngsl12:article.exampleEnglish: The article explains why some birds return to the same garden every year, despite travelling enormous distances.
ngsl12:article.exampleChinese: 这篇文章解释了为什么有些鸟尽管迁徙很远，每年仍返回同一个花园。

ngsl12:fast.exampleEnglish: The river was too fast for our small boat, so the instructor chose a calmer section.
ngsl12:fast.exampleChinese: 河水流速对我们的小船来说太快，所以教练选了一段更平缓的河道。

ngsl12:attack.exampleEnglish: The smaller animal will only attack if it cannot escape or thinks its young are in danger.
ngsl12:attack.exampleChinese: 这种较小的动物只有在无法逃走或认为幼崽有危险时才会攻击。

ngsl12:foreign.exampleEnglish: Studying a foreign language can help you understand everyday customs when you travel to another country.
ngsl12:foreign.exampleChinese: 学习外语可以帮助你在去另一个国家旅行时理解当地日常习俗。

ngsl12:surprise.exampleEnglish: The children hoped to surprise their teacher by decorating the classroom before she arrived that morning.
ngsl12:surprise.exampleChinese: 孩子们希望在老师那天早晨到来前装饰好教室，给她一个惊喜。

ngsl12:feature.exampleEnglish: One useful feature of the app is that it saves your work even without an internet connection.
ngsl12:feature.exampleChinese: 这款应用的一项实用功能是，即使没有网络连接也能保存你的工作。

ngsl12:factor.exampleEnglish: Cost was an important factor in our decision, but we also considered how long the equipment would last.
ngsl12:factor.exampleChinese: 费用是我们决策中的重要因素，但我们也考虑了设备能使用多久。

ngsl12:pretty.exampleEnglish: The village square looked particularly pretty when the evening lights came on around the old stone fountain.
ngsl12:pretty.exampleChinese: 傍晚，古老石喷泉周围的灯亮起时，村庄广场显得格外漂亮。

ngsl12:recently.exampleEnglish: The library recently introduced longer opening hours after students asked for somewhere quiet to study after school.
ngsl12:recently.exampleChinese: 学生们希望放学后有个安静的学习场所，因此图书馆最近延长了开放时间。

ngsl12:affect.exampleEnglish: The roadworks may affect your journey to school, particularly if you usually travel during the morning rush hour.
ngsl12:affect.exampleChinese: 道路施工可能影响你上学的路程，尤其是当你通常在早高峰出行时。

ngsl12:drop.exampleEnglish: Be careful not to drop the glass bowl while you carry it across the wet kitchen floor.
ngsl12:drop.exampleChinese: 端着玻璃碗走过湿漉漉的厨房地板时，小心别把它掉在地上。

ngsl12:recent.exampleEnglish: The recent changes to the timetable have made it easier for people to reach the hospital.
ngsl12:recent.exampleChinese: 最近的时刻表调整让人们更容易到达医院。

ngsl12:relate.exampleEnglish: The exercise asks us to relate the ideas in the article to problems in our own community.
ngsl12:relate.exampleChinese: 这项练习要求我们把文章中的观点与自己社区的问题联系起来。

collocations.chinese: 将某事与某事联系起来

ngsl12:official.exampleEnglish: We waited for an official announcement before telling our customers that the event had been postponed.
ngsl12:official.exampleChinese: 我们等到正式公告发布后，才告诉顾客活动已延期。

ngsl12:financial.exampleEnglish: The group needs financial support to repair the old hall and keep it open for community activities.
ngsl12:financial.exampleChinese: 这个团体需要资金支持，以修缮旧礼堂并让它继续用于社区活动。

ngsl12:miss.exampleEnglish: We left the exhibition early because we did not want to miss the last bus home.
ngsl12:miss.exampleChinese: 我们提前离开展览，因为不想错过回家的末班公交车。

ngsl12:art.exampleEnglish: The exhibition combines art and science by showing how artists use light to create surprising effects.
ngsl12:art.exampleChinese: 这场展览展示艺术家如何利用光线创造惊人效果，将艺术与科学结合起来。

ngsl12:campaign.exampleEnglish: Local residents campaign for safer crossings because many children walk along the main road to school.
ngsl12:campaign.exampleChinese: 当地居民为更安全的人行横道开展活动，因为许多孩子沿主路步行上学。

ngsl12:private.exampleEnglish: The hotel has a private garden where guests can relax away from the noise of the main street.
ngsl12:private.exampleChinese: 这家酒店有一座私家花园，客人可以远离主街噪声，在那里放松。

ngsl12:pause.exampleEnglish: The speaker decided to pause for a moment so that the audience could study the diagram carefully.
ngsl12:pause.exampleChinese: 演讲者决定暂停片刻，让观众能仔细研究图示。

ngsl12:everyone.exampleEnglish: Everyone who joined the trip was asked to bring water, as there were no shops along the route.
ngsl12:everyone.exampleChinese: 所有参加旅行的人都被要求带水，因为沿途没有商店。

ngsl12:forget.exampleEnglish: Do not forget to save your work before leaving, especially if the computer is shared with other students.
ngsl12:forget.exampleChinese: 离开前别忘了保存工作，尤其是当这台电脑与其他学生共用时。

ngsl12:page.exampleEnglish: On the last page of the booklet, you will find a map showing all the walking routes.
ngsl12:page.exampleChinese: 在小册子的最后一页，你会找到一张标有所有步行路线的地图。

ngsl12:worry.exampleEnglish: Try not to worry about making mistakes, because they can help you notice what you need to practise.
ngsl12:worry.exampleChinese: 尽量别担心犯错，因为错误可以帮助你发现需要练习什么。

ngsl12:summer.exampleEnglish: We spent the summer helping our grandparents repair their house before they moved back in that autumn.
ngsl12:summer.exampleChinese: 那个夏天，我们帮祖父母修房子，之后他们在秋天搬了回去。

ngsl12:drink.exampleEnglish: After walking for several hours in warm weather, we stopped to drink water in the shade.
ngsl12:drink.exampleChinese: 在暖和的天气里走了几个小时后，我们停在阴凉处喝水。

ngsl12:opinion.exampleEnglish: In my opinion, the best part of the course was being able to practise with other learners.
ngsl12:opinion.exampleChinese: 我认为，这门课程最棒的地方是能够与其他学习者一起练习。

ngsl12:park.exampleEnglish: You can park behind the library, provided you leave enough space for the delivery van to pass.
ngsl12:park.exampleChinese: 你可以把车停在图书馆后面，前提是留下足够的空间让送货车通过。

ngsl12:represent.exampleEnglish: Two students will represent our class at the meeting and explain the changes we would like to see.
ngsl12:represent.exampleChinese: 两名学生将代表我们班参加会议，说明我们希望看到的改变。

ngsl12:key.exampleEnglish: I gave my neighbour a spare key so that she could water the plants while we were away.
ngsl12:key.exampleChinese: 我给邻居一把备用钥匙，方便她在我们外出时给植物浇水。

ngsl12:inside.exampleEnglish: The inside pockets are large enough to hold a phone, which makes the jacket useful for travelling.
ngsl12:inside.exampleChinese: 内侧口袋大到足以装下手机，这让这件夹克很适合旅行。

ngsl12:manager.exampleEnglish: The manager asked the team for suggestions before deciding how to improve the shop's opening hours.
ngsl12:manager.exampleChinese: 经理在决定如何调整商店营业时间前，向团队征求了建议。

ngsl12:international.exampleEnglish: The town hosts an international music festival that attracts performers and visitors from many different countries.
ngsl12:international.exampleChinese: 这个城镇举办国际音乐节，吸引来自许多不同国家的表演者和游客。

ngsl12:contain.exampleEnglish: The box may contain fragile items, so please keep it upright while carrying it upstairs carefully.
ngsl12:contain.exampleChinese: 箱内可能装有易碎品，所以小心往楼上搬时请保持竖直。

ngsl12:notice.exampleEnglish: Did you notice the new sign near the entrance, which explains where bicycles should be left?
ngsl12:notice.exampleChinese: 你注意到入口附近那块新指示牌了吗？上面说明了自行车应停在哪里。

ngsl12:wonder.exampleEnglish: The children watched in wonder as the butterfly slowly opened its wings and flew towards the window.
ngsl12:wonder.exampleChinese: 孩子们惊奇地看着蝴蝶慢慢展开翅膀，飞向窗户。

ngsl12:nature.exampleEnglish: Spending time in nature helps me relax, especially after a week of working inside a busy office.
ngsl12:nature.exampleChinese: 在大自然中度过时光有助于我放松，尤其是在繁忙办公室工作一周之后。

ngsl12:structure.exampleEnglish: The structure of the building allows plenty of light to enter without making the rooms too hot.
ngsl12:structure.exampleChinese: 这栋建筑的结构让大量光线进入，同时不会使房间过热。

ngsl12:section.exampleEnglish: Read the final section carefully because it explains what to do if the machine stops working.
ngsl12:section.exampleChinese: 仔细阅读最后一节，因为它解释了机器停止运转时该怎么做。

ngsl12:myself.exampleEnglish: I made the shelves myself, although a friend showed me how to use the tools safely first.
ngsl12:myself.exampleChinese: 这些架子是我自己做的，不过一位朋友事先教我如何安全使用工具。

ngsl12:exactly.exampleEnglish: Please tell me exactly where you left the bag, so that I can help you look for it.
ngsl12:exactly.exampleChinese: 请准确告诉我你把包放在哪里了，这样我才能帮你找。

ngsl12:plant.exampleEnglish: The plant beside my window grows towards the light, so I turn its pot every few days.
ngsl12:plant.exampleChinese: 窗边的植物朝着光线生长，所以我每隔几天就转动一下花盆。

ngsl12:paint.exampleEnglish: We decided to paint the walls a lighter colour because the room receives little natural light.
ngsl12:paint.exampleChinese: 我们决定把墙刷成较浅的颜色，因为房间里的自然光很少。

ngsl12:worker.exampleEnglish: Each worker received training before using the new equipment, even if they had done similar jobs before.
ngsl12:worker.exampleChinese: 每位工人在使用新设备前都接受了培训，即使以前做过类似的工作。

ngsl12:press.exampleEnglish: Press the green button once the light stops flashing, and the machine will begin printing your ticket.
ngsl12:press.exampleChinese: 指示灯停止闪烁后按绿色按钮，机器就会开始打印你的车票。

ngsl12:whatever.exampleEnglish: You can choose whatever materials you need, as long as you put the unused ones away afterwards.
ngsl12:whatever.exampleChinese: 你可以选择任何需要的材料，只要事后把没用的收好。

ngsl12:necessary.exampleEnglish: It is necessary to book a place in advance because the workshop can only accommodate twelve people.
ngsl12:necessary.exampleChinese: 有必要提前预约，因为这个工作坊只能容纳十二个人。

ngsl12:region.exampleEnglish: The region is famous for its fruit farms, which supply fresh produce to markets across the country.
ngsl12:region.exampleChinese: 这个地区以果园闻名，向全国各地的市场供应新鲜农产品。

ngsl12:growth.exampleEnglish: The growth of the town has increased demand for housing and put pressure on local transport services.
ngsl12:growth.exampleChinese: 城镇的发展增加了住房需求，也给当地交通服务带来了压力。

ngsl12:evening.exampleEnglish: We spent the evening planning our trip, although we still could not agree on which route to take.
ngsl12:evening.exampleChinese: 我们花了一个晚上规划旅行，不过仍未能就路线达成一致。

ngsl12:influence.exampleEnglish: The books we read as children can influence the way we understand the world many years later.
ngsl12:influence.exampleChinese: 童年读过的书会影响我们多年后理解世界的方式。

ngsl12:respect.exampleEnglish: I respect her ability to stay calm when everyone else is worried about finishing the work on time.
ngsl12:respect.exampleChinese: 当其他人都担心能否按时完工时，她还能保持冷静，我敬佩她这种能力。

ngsl12:various.exampleEnglish: The museum offers various activities that allow visitors to discover how people lived several hundred years ago.
ngsl12:various.exampleChinese: 博物馆提供各种活动，让访客了解几百年前人们如何生活。

ngsl12:catch.exampleEnglish: I managed to catch the ball before it rolled under a car parked beside the school gate.
ngsl12:catch.exampleChinese: 球滚到校门旁停着的汽车下面之前，我设法接住了它。

ngsl12:thus.exampleEnglish: The new path avoids the main road, thus making the journey to school safer for children.
ngsl12:thus.exampleChinese: 这条新小路避开了主路，因此让孩子们上学的路程更加安全。

ngsl12:skill.exampleEnglish: Learning a practical skill can increase your confidence, especially when you use it to help someone else.
ngsl12:skill.exampleChinese: 学习一项实用技能可以增强信心，尤其是当你用它帮助别人的时候。

ngsl12:attempt.exampleEnglish: Do not attempt to move the heavy cupboard alone, because it could damage the floor or injure you.
ngsl12:attempt.exampleChinese: 不要试图独自搬动这个重柜子，因为它可能损坏地板或使你受伤。

ngsl12:son.exampleEnglish: Their son chose to study in another city, although he still returns home most weekends to visit.
ngsl12:son.exampleChinese: 他们的儿子选择去另一座城市读书，不过大多数周末仍回家探望。

ngsl12:simple.exampleEnglish: The instructions are simple enough for beginners, but the final task still requires patience and careful planning.
ngsl12:simple.exampleChinese: 说明足够简单，初学者也能懂，但最后的任务仍需要耐心和仔细规划。

ngsl12:medium.exampleEnglish: The jacket in a medium fitted my shoulders, but I needed a large to wear a thick jumper underneath.
ngsl12:medium.exampleChinese: 这件夹克中码的肩部合适，但要在里面穿厚毛衣就需要大码。

ngsl12:average.exampleEnglish: An average family in the area spends more on transport than families living near the city centre.
ngsl12:average.exampleChinese: 这个地区的普通家庭花在交通上的钱比住在市中心附近的家庭多。

ngsl12:stock.exampleEnglish: The shop keeps extra stock during the holiday season because deliveries can take longer than usual.
ngsl12:stock.exampleChinese: 假日季节这家商店会保留额外库存，因为送货可能比平时更慢。

ngsl12:management.exampleEnglish: The management agreed to change the rota after staff explained why the current arrangements were difficult.
ngsl12:management.exampleChinese: 员工解释了现有安排的困难后，管理层同意更改轮班表。

ngsl12:character.exampleEnglish: Her patient character makes her a good person to work with when a task becomes unexpectedly difficult.
ngsl12:character.exampleChinese: 她耐心的性格让她在任务意外变难时，仍是一位很好的合作伙伴。

ngsl12:bed.exampleEnglish: I left the book beside the bed so that I could finish reading it before going to sleep.
ngsl12:bed.exampleChinese: 我把书放在床边，以便睡前读完。

ngsl12:hit.exampleEnglish: The ball hit the window with such force that everyone in the classroom turned towards the noise.
ngsl12:hit.exampleChinese: 球用力撞上窗户，教室里所有人都朝响声转过头。

ngsl12:establish.exampleEnglish: The group hopes to establish a regular meeting place where residents can share ideas and solve local problems.
ngsl12:establish.exampleChinese: 这个团体希望建立一个固定会面场所，让居民分享想法、解决当地问题。

ngsl12:indeed.exampleEnglish: The journey was tiring indeed, but the view from the mountain made every step feel worthwhile.
ngsl12:indeed.exampleChinese: 这趟旅程的确很累，但山顶的景色让每一步都显得值得。

ngsl12:final.exampleEnglish: The final version of the report includes several changes that were suggested during our meeting last week.
ngsl12:final.exampleChinese: 报告的最终版本包含几处上周会议中提出的修改。

ngsl12:economy.exampleEnglish: Tourism supports the local economy, but residents are concerned about the number of visitors arriving each summer.
ngsl12:economy.exampleChinese: 旅游业支撑着当地经济，但居民担心每年夏季到访的游客数量。

ngsl12:fit.exampleEnglish: The old hall is no longer fit for public use because its roof needs extensive repairs.
ngsl12:fit.exampleChinese: 旧礼堂已经不适合向公众开放，因为屋顶需要大规模维修。

ngsl12:guy.exampleEnglish: The guy at the information desk showed us a quieter route that avoided the busy shopping streets.
ngsl12:guy.exampleChinese: 咨询台那位男子给我们指了一条较安静、避开繁忙商业街的路线。

ngsl12:function.exampleEnglish: The main function of the roof is to keep rain out, although it also helps control temperature.
ngsl12:function.exampleChinese: 屋顶的主要功能是挡雨，不过它也有助于调节温度。

ngsl12:yesterday.exampleEnglish: We were planning to leave yesterday, but the storm forced us to stay for another night.
ngsl12:yesterday.exampleChinese: 我们原计划昨天离开，但暴风雨迫使我们多留了一晚。

ngsl12:image.exampleEnglish: The image on the poster shows how the town might look once the building work is complete.
ngsl12:image.exampleChinese: 海报上的图片展示了工程完成后，这个城镇可能的样子。

ngsl12:size.exampleEnglish: Check the size of the cupboard carefully before buying it, because the doorway is rather narrow.
ngsl12:size.exampleChinese: 购买前请仔细检查柜子的尺寸，因为门口相当窄。

ngsl12:behavior.exampleEnglish: The teacher explained that respectful behavior was expected throughout the visit, especially inside the quiet exhibition rooms.
ngsl12:behavior.exampleChinese: 老师解释说，参观全程都要举止有礼，尤其是在安静的展厅内。

ngsl12:addition.exampleEnglish: The addition of a small table made the kitchen a much more comfortable place to spend time.
ngsl12:addition.exampleChinese: 添了一张小桌子后，厨房成了一个舒适得多的活动空间。

ngsl12:determine.exampleEnglish: The amount of space available will determine how many tables we can put in the hall safely.
ngsl12:determine.exampleChinese: 可用空间的大小将决定我们能在大厅内安全摆放多少张桌子。

ngsl12:station.exampleEnglish: We agreed to meet outside the station, where there would be enough room for everyone to wait.
ngsl12:station.exampleChinese: 我们约定在车站外见面，那里有足够的地方供大家等候。

ngsl12:population.exampleEnglish: The population of the town has grown since a new railway line made travel to the city easier.
ngsl12:population.exampleChinese: 新铁路线让进城更方便后，这个城镇的人口增加了。

ngsl12:fail.exampleEnglish: Even careful plans can fail if people do not understand what they are expected to do.
ngsl12:fail.exampleChinese: 即使计划周密，如果人们不明白自己该做什么，计划也可能失败。

ngsl12:environment.exampleEnglish: The students studied how plastic waste affects the environment before suggesting ways to reduce it at school.
ngsl12:environment.exampleChinese: 学生们先研究塑料废弃物如何影响环境，然后提出在学校减少塑料垃圾的方法。

ngsl12:production.exampleEnglish: The factory reduced production during the winter because fewer customers were ordering its outdoor furniture than usual.
ngsl12:production.exampleChinese: 工厂在冬季减少了生产，因为订购户外家具的顾客比平时少。

ngsl12:contract.exampleEnglish: Read the contract carefully before signing, especially the section that explains when either side can end the agreement.
ngsl12:contract.exampleChinese: 签字前仔细阅读合同，尤其是说明任何一方何时能终止协议的部分。

ngsl12:player.exampleEnglish: Every player on the team helped defend the goal when their opponents attacked in the final minutes.
ngsl12:player.exampleChinese: 对手在最后几分钟进攻时，队里每位球员都参与防守球门。

ngsl12:comment.exampleEnglish: Her comment about the confusing map led us to add clearer directions to the information sheet.
ngsl12:comment.exampleChinese: 她对地图难以看懂的评论，促使我们在信息表上添加了更清楚的指引。

ngsl12:enter.exampleEnglish: Visitors must show their tickets before they enter the building, even if they have already booked online.
ngsl12:enter.exampleChinese: 访客进入大楼前必须出示门票，即使已经在线预订。

ngsl12:occur.exampleEnglish: Small delays often occur at this station because trains from several different routes share the same platforms.
ngsl12:occur.exampleChinese: 这个车站经常出现小幅延误，因为几条不同线路的火车共用站台。

ngsl12:alone.exampleEnglish: Although she travelled alone, she met several friendly people who were following the same walking route.
ngsl12:alone.exampleChinese: 虽然她独自旅行，却结识了几位走同一条徒步路线的友好旅伴。

ngsl12:significant.exampleEnglish: The new crossing has made a significant difference to families who walk to school along this road.
ngsl12:significant.exampleChinese: 新的人行横道给沿这条路步行上学的家庭带来了明显改变。

ngsl12:drug.exampleEnglish: The leaflet explains how the drug should be stored, so the pharmacist asked her to read it carefully.
ngsl12:drug.exampleChinese: 说明书解释了这种药物该如何保存，因此药剂师让她仔细阅读。

ngsl12:wall.exampleEnglish: We hung the map on the wall where everyone could see it while discussing the next day's route.
ngsl12:wall.exampleChinese: 我们把地图挂在人人都能看见的墙上，讨论第二天的路线。

ngsl12:series.exampleEnglish: The museum is holding a series of evening talks about how the city developed over the centuries.
ngsl12:series.exampleChinese: 博物馆正在举办一系列晚间讲座，介绍这座城市几个世纪以来的发展。

ngsl12:direct.exampleEnglish: The guide will direct visitors towards the side entrance while workers repair the steps outside the main door.
ngsl12:direct.exampleChinese: 工作人员维修正门外的台阶时，导游会引导游客走向侧门。

ngsl12:success.exampleEnglish: The success of the event depended on volunteers who worked quietly behind the scenes for several weeks.
ngsl12:success.exampleChinese: 活动的成功依赖于那些连续几周在幕后默默工作的志愿者。

ngsl12:tomorrow.exampleEnglish: We will decide tomorrow whether to continue with the walk, once we have checked the latest weather forecast.
ngsl12:tomorrow.exampleChinese: 明天查看最新天气预报后，我们将决定是否继续徒步。

ngsl12:director.exampleEnglish: The director of the museum explained why some rooms would remain closed until the repairs were complete.
ngsl12:director.exampleChinese: 博物馆馆长解释了为什么有些房间要等维修完成后才开放。

ngsl12:clearly.exampleEnglish: The instructions clearly state that children must be accompanied by an adult when using the climbing wall.
ngsl12:clearly.exampleChinese: 说明清楚地写明，儿童使用攀岩墙时必须有成人陪同。

ngsl12:lack.exampleEnglish: Some villages lack regular bus services, which makes it difficult for residents without cars to reach the hospital.
ngsl12:lack.exampleChinese: 有些村庄缺乏固定的公交服务，使没有汽车的居民很难去医院。

ngsl12:review.exampleEnglish: We will review the arrangements after the first month to see whether the new opening hours are working well.
ngsl12:review.exampleChinese: 第一个月结束后，我们会评估安排，看看新的开放时间效果如何。

ngsl12:depend.exampleEnglish: Whether we can hold the concert outdoors will depend on how quickly the field dries after the rain.
ngsl12:depend.exampleChinese: 音乐会能否在户外举行，将取决于雨后场地有多快干燥。

ngsl12:race.exampleEnglish: The race was postponed because strong winds made the final section of the course unsafe for runners.
ngsl12:race.exampleChinese: 由于大风使赛道最后一段对跑者不安全，比赛延期了。

ngsl12:recognize.exampleEnglish: I did not recognize my old classmate at first because we had not seen each other for years.
ngsl12:recognize.exampleChinese: 我起初没有认出老同学，因为我们已多年未见。

ngsl12:window.exampleEnglish: We opened the window slightly so that fresh air could enter without making the classroom too cold.
ngsl12:window.exampleChinese: 我们把窗户稍微打开，让新鲜空气进来，同时不让教室太冷。

ngsl12:purpose.exampleEnglish: The purpose of the meeting is to hear residents' concerns before the council makes its final decision.
ngsl12:purpose.exampleChinese: 会议的目的是在市政委员会做出最终决定前，听取居民的担忧。

ngsl12:department.exampleEnglish: The science department has borrowed equipment from a nearby college so that students can try more experiments.
ngsl12:department.exampleChinese: 科学系向附近一所学院借了设备，让学生能尝试更多实验。

ngsl12:gain.exampleEnglish: Volunteering at the centre helped her gain experience that later proved useful when she applied for work.
ngsl12:gain.exampleChinese: 在中心做志愿服务帮助她积累了经验，后来申请工作时证明这些经验很有用。

ngsl12:tree.exampleEnglish: The tree outside our kitchen window provides shade in summer, but its leaves block the gutter every autumn.
ngsl12:tree.exampleChinese: 厨房窗外的树在夏天提供荫凉，但每到秋天树叶就会堵住排水槽。

ngsl12:college.exampleEnglish: She chose a college close to home because it offered the practical course she wanted to study.
ngsl12:college.exampleChinese: 她选了一所离家近的学院，因为那里有她想读的实践课程。

ngsl12:argue.exampleEnglish: Some residents argue that the new playground should include equipment suitable for older children as well.
ngsl12:argue.exampleChinese: 一些居民主张，新游乐场还应配备适合年龄较大孩子的设施。

ngsl12:board.exampleEnglish: The notice on the board explains which rooms are available and who to contact about booking them.
ngsl12:board.exampleChinese: 公告板上的通知说明了哪些房间可用，以及预订时该联系谁。

ngsl12:holiday.exampleEnglish: We are planning a holiday in the mountains, where we can walk without using the car every day.
ngsl12:holiday.exampleChinese: 我们计划去山里度假，那里可以徒步，不必每天开车。

ngsl12:mark.exampleEnglish: Please mark any errors you find in pencil so that the writer can correct them before printing.
ngsl12:mark.exampleChinese: 请用铅笔标出发现的错误，方便作者在打印前改正。

ngsl12:church.exampleEnglish: The old church is open to visitors on weekdays, although services take place there every Sunday morning.
ngsl12:church.exampleChinese: 这座老教堂工作日对游客开放，不过每周日早晨那里都会举行礼拜。

ngsl12:machine.exampleEnglish: The machine stops automatically if the cover is opened, which prevents people from touching the moving parts.
ngsl12:machine.exampleChinese: 如果盖子被打开，机器就会自动停止，以防人们触碰活动部件。

ngsl12:achieve.exampleEnglish: She worked steadily towards her goal and managed to achieve it earlier than anyone had expected.
ngsl12:achieve.exampleChinese: 她稳步朝目标努力，设法比所有人预想的更早实现了它。

ngsl12:item.exampleEnglish: Each item on the list must be checked before the boxes are loaded onto the delivery van.
ngsl12:item.exampleChinese: 在把箱子装上送货车前，清单上的每件物品都必须核对。

ngsl12:prove.exampleEnglish: The experiment helped prove that the amount of light affected how quickly the young plants grew.
ngsl12:prove.exampleChinese: 这次实验有助于证明，光照量影响了幼苗的生长速度。

ngsl12:cent.exampleEnglish: The children saved every cent they earned because they wanted to buy equipment for their school garden.
ngsl12:cent.exampleChinese: 孩子们把挣来的每一分钱都存起来，因为他们想为学校花园买工具。

ngsl12:season.exampleEnglish: Spring is the best season to visit the valley because the paths are quiet and the flowers are blooming.
ngsl12:season.exampleChinese: 春季是游览山谷的最佳季节，因为小路安静，鲜花盛开。

ngsl12:floor.exampleEnglish: We covered the floor before painting the ceiling so that any falling paint would not damage the wood.
ngsl12:floor.exampleChinese: 刷天花板前，我们盖住地板，防止滴落的油漆损坏木材。

ngsl12:stuff.exampleEnglish: We packed all the camping stuff into the car before checking whether there was room for our bags.
ngsl12:stuff.exampleChinese: 我们把所有露营用品装进车里后，才检查行李包是否还有地方放。

ngsl12:wide.exampleEnglish: The doorway is wide enough for a wheelchair, although the short ramp outside still needs repairing.
ngsl12:wide.exampleChinese: 门口足够宽，能让轮椅通过，不过外面那段短坡道仍需维修。

ngsl12:anyone.exampleEnglish: If anyone needs help with the application, a volunteer will be available at the library this afternoon.
ngsl12:anyone.exampleChinese: 如果有人需要填写申请方面的帮助，今天下午图书馆会有一名志愿者提供协助。

ngsl12:method.exampleEnglish: The teacher demonstrated a method for checking calculations that did not require us to use a calculator.
ngsl12:method.exampleChinese: 老师演示了一种不需要计算器的计算结果检查方法。

ngsl12:analysis.exampleEnglish: Our analysis of the survey showed that most visitors wanted more information about the walking routes.
ngsl12:analysis.exampleChinese: 我们对调查的分析表明，大多数游客希望得到更多步行路线信息。

ngsl12:election.exampleEnglish: Candidates visited local schools before the election to explain how they would improve services for young people.
ngsl12:election.exampleChinese: 选举前，候选人走访当地学校，说明他们将如何改善面向年轻人的服务。

ngsl12:military.exampleEnglish: The museum explains how the military helped build roads that later became important routes for local trade.
ngsl12:military.exampleChinese: 博物馆解释了军队如何帮助修建道路，而这些道路后来成了当地贸易的重要路线。

ngsl12:hotel.exampleEnglish: We chose a hotel near the station so that we would not need a taxi after arriving late.
ngsl12:hotel.exampleChinese: 我们选了车站附近的酒店，以便晚到时不必叫出租车。

ngsl12:club.exampleEnglish: The club welcomes beginners and provides equipment for people who want to try the sport before buying their own.
ngsl12:club.exampleChinese: 俱乐部欢迎初学者，并为想先尝试运动再购买自用器材的人提供设备。

ngsl12:below.exampleEnglish: The temperature dropped below freezing during the night, so the paths were still icy in the morning.
ngsl12:below.exampleChinese: 夜间气温降到冰点以下，所以早晨小路上仍然结着冰。

ngsl12:movie.exampleEnglish: The movie follows a family who move to a new country and gradually learn to feel at home.
ngsl12:movie.exampleChinese: 这部电影讲述一个家庭移居异国并逐渐找到归属感的故事。

ngsl12:doctor.exampleEnglish: The doctor asked several questions about her daily routine before suggesting that she keep a sleep diary.
ngsl12:doctor.exampleChinese: 医生问了几个关于她日常作息的问题，然后建议她记录睡眠日记。

ngsl12:discussion.exampleEnglish: The discussion became more useful once everyone had a chance to describe the problems they were facing.
ngsl12:discussion.exampleChinese: 每个人都有机会描述自己面临的问题之后，讨论变得更有帮助了。

ngsl12:sorry.exampleEnglish: I am sorry that we kept you waiting, but the earlier meeting took longer than we expected.
ngsl12:sorry.exampleChinese: 很抱歉让你久等了，但之前的会议比我们预计的更长。

ngsl12:challenge.exampleEnglish: Designing a bridge from paper was a challenge that encouraged the students to test several different ideas.
ngsl12:challenge.exampleChinese: 用纸设计一座桥是一项挑战，鼓励了学生们测试多种不同想法。

ngsl12:nation.exampleEnglish: The festival brings together performers from across the nation to celebrate music that is rarely heard elsewhere.
ngsl12:nation.exampleChinese: 这个节日汇聚了全国的表演者，庆祝在其他地方很少听到的音乐。

ngsl12:nearly.exampleEnglish: We had nearly finished packing when we discovered that one of the bags was too heavy to carry.
ngsl12:nearly.exampleChinese: 我们快打包完时，才发现其中一个包重得搬不动。

ngsl12:statement.exampleEnglish: The council released a statement explaining why the bridge would remain closed until engineers completed their checks.
ngsl12:statement.exampleChinese: 市政委员会发表声明，解释为什么桥梁要等工程师完成检查后才会开放。

ngsl12:link.exampleEnglish: The new cycle path will link the station to the park, making the journey easier for local families.
ngsl12:link.exampleChinese: 新自行车道将连接车站和公园，让当地家庭出行更方便。

ngsl12:despite.exampleEnglish: Despite the heavy rain, the volunteers arrived on time and helped move the equipment into the hall.
ngsl12:despite.exampleChinese: 尽管下着大雨，志愿者们仍准时赶到，帮忙把设备搬进大厅。

ngsl12:introduce.exampleEnglish: Before we begin the workshop, I would like to introduce the people who will be helping us today.
ngsl12:introduce.exampleChinese: 在工作坊开始前，我想介绍一下今天将协助我们的几位工作人员。

ngsl12:advantage.exampleEnglish: One advantage of living near the station is that we can reach the city without driving.
ngsl12:advantage.exampleChinese: 住在车站附近的一个好处是，我们不开车也能进城。

ngsl12:ready.exampleEnglish: Please have your tickets ready before you reach the entrance, so that everyone can get inside quickly.
ngsl12:ready.exampleChinese: 到达入口前请准备好门票，方便大家快速入场。

ngsl12:marry.exampleEnglish: They decided to marry in the village where they first met, although neither of them lived there anymore.
ngsl12:marry.exampleChinese: 他们决定在初次见面的村庄结婚，尽管两人都已不再住在那里。

ngsl12:strike.exampleEnglish: A loose branch could strike the window during the storm, so we moved the table away from the glass.
ngsl12:strike.exampleChinese: 暴风雨中，一根松动的树枝可能撞上窗户，所以我们把桌子移离了玻璃。

ngsl12:mile.exampleEnglish: The nearest shop is over a mile away, so we usually buy everything we need in one visit.
ngsl12:mile.exampleChinese: 最近的商店有一英里多远，所以我们通常一次买齐所需物品。

ngsl12:seek.exampleEnglish: The organisers will seek advice from local residents before deciding where the new playground should be built.
ngsl12:seek.exampleChinese: 组织者将在决定新游乐场建在哪里之前，向当地居民征求意见。

ngsl12:ability.exampleEnglish: Her ability to explain complicated ideas clearly made the training session useful for people with little experience.
ngsl12:ability.exampleChinese: 她能清楚解释复杂概念，这让经验不多的人也能从培训中受益。

ngsl12:unit.exampleEnglish: Each unit in the course builds on the previous one, so it is worth completing them in order.
ngsl12:unit.exampleChinese: 课程的每个单元都建立在前一个单元的基础上，因此值得按顺序完成。

ngsl12:card.exampleEnglish: You must show your membership card at the desk before borrowing equipment from the sports centre.
ngsl12:card.exampleChinese: 在体育中心借用器材前，你必须在服务台出示会员卡。

ngsl12:hospital.exampleEnglish: The hospital opened a new entrance so that visitors could reach the children's ward more easily.
ngsl12:hospital.exampleChinese: 这家医院开设了一个新入口，让访客能更容易到达儿科病房。

ngsl12:quickly.exampleEnglish: We moved the chairs quickly when the rain started, but managed to keep most of the cushions dry.
ngsl12:quickly.exampleChinese: 下雨时我们迅速搬走了椅子，设法让大多数坐垫没有淋湿。

ngsl12:interview.exampleEnglish: The students will interview older residents to discover how the town has changed since they were young.
ngsl12:interview.exampleChinese: 学生们将采访年长居民，了解这个城镇自他们年轻时起发生了哪些变化。

ngsl12:agreement.exampleEnglish: We reached an agreement on the route after everyone explained which places they most wanted to visit.
ngsl12:agreement.exampleChinese: 每个人说明自己最想游览哪些地方后，我们就路线达成了一致。

ngsl12:release.exampleEnglish: The rescue centre will release the bird once its wing has healed and it can fly safely again.
ngsl12:release.exampleChinese: 等鸟的翅膀痊愈、能够再次安全飞行后，救助中心就会放归它。

ngsl12:tax.exampleEnglish: The price on the label includes tax, so you will not pay anything extra at the checkout.
ngsl12:tax.exampleChinese: 标签上的价格含税，所以结账时不用再额外支付。

ngsl12:solution.exampleEnglish: We found a solution that allowed both groups to use the hall without changing their regular meeting times.
ngsl12:solution.exampleChinese: 我们找到一个解决办法，让两个小组都能使用大厅，而不用改变各自固定的会面时间。

ngsl12:capital.exampleEnglish: The capital city attracts visitors throughout the year, although many prefer to explore its quieter neighbourhoods in spring.
ngsl12:capital.exampleChinese: 这座首都全年都吸引着游客，不过许多人更喜欢在春天探索其较安静的街区。
ngsl12:capital.chinese: 首都的；主要的；极重要的

ngsl12:popular.exampleEnglish: The cafe has become popular with students because it provides quiet tables and stays open until late.
ngsl12:popular.exampleChinese: 这家咖啡馆提供安静的桌位并营业至深夜，因此很受学生欢迎。

ngsl12:specific.exampleEnglish: Please give a specific example when you explain the problem, so that we know what needs changing.
ngsl12:specific.exampleChinese: 解释问题时请举出具体例子，以便我们知道需要改变什么。

ngsl12:beautiful.exampleEnglish: The garden is especially beautiful in early spring, when flowers appear beneath the trees beside the lake.
ngsl12:beautiful.exampleChinese: 早春时，湖边树下开出鲜花，花园格外美丽。

ngsl12:fear.exampleEnglish: Her fear of deep water gradually decreased after she practised swimming with an instructor she trusted.
ngsl12:fear.exampleChinese: 她跟随信任的教练练习游泳后，对深水的恐惧逐渐减轻了。

ngsl12:aim.exampleEnglish: His aim improved after the coach showed him how to hold the bow without moving his shoulders.
ngsl12:aim.exampleChinese: 教练教他如何在不移动肩膀的情况下持弓后，他瞄得更准了。

ngsl12:television.exampleEnglish: We turned off the television during dinner so that everyone could talk about what had happened that day.
ngsl12:television.exampleChinese: 吃晚饭时我们关掉电视，让大家都能聊聊当天发生的事。

ngsl12:serious.exampleEnglish: The shortage of water became a serious problem after the region went several weeks without rain.
ngsl12:serious.exampleChinese: 这个地区连续数周没有下雨后，缺水成了一个严重问题。

ngsl12:target.exampleEnglish: The team reached its target earlier than expected, so it decided to spend more time checking the quality.
ngsl12:target.exampleChinese: 团队比预期更早达到目标，于是决定花更多时间检查质量。

ngsl12:degree.exampleEnglish: Even a difference of one degree can affect the results, so we checked the thermometer before each test.
ngsl12:degree.exampleChinese: 即使相差一度也会影响结果，所以每次测试前我们都检查温度计。

ngsl12:pull.exampleEnglish: Pull the handle gently towards you until the door opens, then keep it clear of the passing trolley.
ngsl12:pull.exampleChinese: 把手柄轻轻拉向自己，直到门打开，然后别让门挡住经过的手推车。

ngsl12:red.exampleEnglish: She tied a red ribbon around her suitcase handle so that she could recognize it at the airport.
ngsl12:red.exampleChinese: 她在行李箱把手上系了一条红丝带，以便在机场认出它。

ngsl12:husband.exampleEnglish: Her husband offered to collect the children so that she could stay and finish the training session.
ngsl12:husband.exampleChinese: 她丈夫主动提出去接孩子，让她能留下来完成培训。

ngsl12:access.exampleEnglish: The building has step-free access at the side, which makes it easier for visitors using wheelchairs.
ngsl12:access.exampleChinese: 建筑侧面设有无台阶通道，方便使用轮椅的访客。

ngsl12:movement.exampleEnglish: The camera detects movement near the entrance and switches on a light when someone approaches after dark.
ngsl12:movement.exampleChinese: 摄像头检测入口附近的移动，天黑后有人靠近时就会开灯。

ngsl12:treat.exampleEnglish: We should treat new members kindly, especially when they are unsure how the group usually works.
ngsl12:treat.exampleChinese: 我们应该友善地对待新成员，尤其是在他们还不熟悉团队惯例时。

ngsl12:identify.exampleEnglish: The labels help visitors identify the plants, even when the flowers that usually make them recognizable have disappeared.
ngsl12:identify.exampleChinese: 标签帮助游客辨认植物，即使那些通常用于识别的花朵已经凋谢。

collocations.chinese: 根据名字确认某人身份

ngsl12:loss.exampleEnglish: The loss of the old playground upset families who had used it regularly for many years.
ngsl12:loss.exampleChinese: 失去旧游乐场让多年来经常在那里活动的家庭感到难过。

ngsl12:shall.exampleEnglish: We shall send you the final details once the venue has confirmed how many people it can accommodate.
ngsl12:shall.exampleChinese: 场地确认可以容纳多少人之后，我们将把最终详情发送给你。

ngsl12:modern.exampleEnglish: The museum combines a modern entrance with the original building, allowing easier access without hiding its history.
ngsl12:modern.exampleChinese: 博物馆将现代入口与原有建筑结合，让出入更方便，同时保留其历史特色。

ngsl12:pressure.exampleEnglish: The pressure inside the tyre was too low, so we stopped to put more air into it.
ngsl12:pressure.exampleChinese: 轮胎内的气压太低，因此我们停下来补气。

ngsl12:bus.exampleEnglish: We caught an earlier bus because the next service would not arrive until after the museum opened.
ngsl12:bus.exampleChinese: 我们乘了更早的一班公交车，因为下一班要在博物馆开门后才到。

ngsl12:treatment.exampleEnglish: Her treatment of the new volunteers made them feel welcome, even though they had little experience.
ngsl12:treatment.exampleChinese: 她对待新志愿者的方式让他们感到受欢迎，尽管他们没什么经验。

ngsl12:conference.exampleEnglish: The conference brought together teachers from different countries to discuss ways of making science lessons more practical.
ngsl12:conference.exampleChinese: 这次会议汇聚了来自不同国家的教师，讨论如何让科学课更注重实践。

ngsl12:yourself.exampleEnglish: You can try the activity yourself after watching the demonstration, but ask for help if anything feels unsafe.
ngsl12:yourself.exampleChinese: 看过演示后，你可以自己试试这个活动，但如果觉得哪里不安全，请寻求帮助。

ngsl12:supply.exampleEnglish: Local farms supply fresh vegetables to the school, which helps children learn where their food comes from.
ngsl12:supply.exampleChinese: 当地农场给学校供应新鲜蔬菜，帮助孩子们了解食物来自哪里。

ngsl12:village.exampleEnglish: The village has only one shop, but a regular bus connects it with the nearest town.
ngsl12:village.exampleChinese: 这个村庄只有一家商店，不过有固定公交连接最近的城镇。

ngsl12:worth.exampleEnglish: She brought several days' worth of food because the nearest shop would be too far away.
ngsl12:worth.exampleChinese: 她带了够吃几天的食物，因为最近的商店实在太远。

ngsl12:natural.exampleEnglish: The path follows the natural shape of the valley, rather than cutting directly through the forest.
ngsl12:natural.exampleChinese: 这条小路顺着山谷的天然地形延伸，而不是直接穿过森林。

ngsl12:express.exampleEnglish: She used a letter to express her thanks because she wanted the volunteers to know how much their help mattered.
ngsl12:express.exampleChinese: 她用信表达谢意，因为想让志愿者知道他们的帮助有多重要。

ngsl12:indicate.exampleEnglish: The arrows indicate which way visitors should walk, helping to prevent crowds from blocking the narrow entrance.
ngsl12:indicate.exampleChinese: 箭头指明游客应往哪边走，有助于防止人群堵住狭窄入口。

ngsl12:attend.exampleEnglish: If you cannot attend the meeting in person, you can still share your suggestions by email beforehand.
ngsl12:attend.exampleChinese: 如果无法亲自出席会议，你仍然可以提前通过电子邮件分享建议。

ngsl12:brother.exampleEnglish: My brother offered to repair the bicycle after noticing that I was having trouble changing the gears.
ngsl12:brother.exampleChinese: 哥哥注意到我换挡有困难后，主动提出帮我修自行车。

ngsl12:investment.exampleEnglish: The new equipment was a considerable investment, but the cafe hoped it would reduce waste over time.
ngsl12:investment.exampleChinese: 新设备是一笔可观的投资，不过咖啡馆希望它能逐渐减少浪费。

ngsl12:score.exampleEnglish: Our team failed to score until the final minute, when a substitute finally found space near the goal.
ngsl12:score.exampleChinese: 我们队直到最后一分钟才得分，当时一名替补终于在球门附近找到空当。

ngsl12:organize.exampleEnglish: We need to organize the equipment before the workshop starts, so that each group has everything it needs.
ngsl12:organize.exampleChinese: 工作坊开始前，我们需要整理器材，让每组都有所需物品。

ngsl12:trip.exampleEnglish: The trip gave the students a chance to see how the ideas from their lessons worked in practice.
ngsl12:trip.exampleChinese: 这次旅行让学生有机会看到课堂中的知识如何在实践中运用。

ngsl12:beyond.exampleEnglish: Beyond the village, the road becomes narrower and passes through fields where visitors rarely stop to explore.
ngsl12:beyond.exampleChinese: 过了村庄，道路变窄，穿过游客很少驻足探索的田野。

ngsl12:sleep.exampleEnglish: I find it easier to sleep when the room is cool and there is no light from screens.
ngsl12:sleep.exampleChinese: 房间凉爽、没有屏幕亮光时，我发现自己更容易入睡。

ngsl12:fish.exampleEnglish: We saw a silver fish near the bank, where the water was clear enough to reveal the stones below.
ngsl12:fish.exampleChinese: 我们在岸边看见了一条银色的鱼，那里的水清得能看见底下的石头。

ngsl12:promise.exampleEnglish: Please do not promise to finish by Friday unless you are sure the materials will arrive in time.
ngsl12:promise.exampleChinese: 除非你确定材料会及时送达，否则请不要承诺周五前完成。

ngsl12:potential.exampleEnglish: The plan offers potential benefits for local businesses, although residents are concerned about the extra traffic.
ngsl12:potential.exampleChinese: 这项计划可能给当地企业带来好处，不过居民担心增加的交通量。

ngsl12:energy.exampleEnglish: After a busy week at work, I rarely have the energy to cook a complicated meal on Friday evening.
ngsl12:energy.exampleChinese: 忙碌地工作一周后，周五晚上我很少有精力做复杂的饭菜。

ngsl12:trouble.exampleEnglish: We had trouble finding the entrance because the sign was hidden behind a large delivery van.
ngsl12:trouble.exampleChinese: 我们很难找到入口，因为标牌被一辆大型送货车挡住了。

ngsl12:relation.exampleEnglish: The relation between the two groups improved after they began working together on the village garden.
ngsl12:relation.exampleChinese: 两个团体开始合作打理村庄花园之后，彼此关系改善了。

ngsl12:touch.exampleEnglish: Do not touch the painted surface until it is completely dry, even if it looks ready.
ngsl12:touch.exampleChinese: 即使表面看起来已经好了，在油漆完全干燥前也不要触摸。

ngsl12:file.exampleEnglish: You must file the application before the closing date if you want the council to consider your request.
ngsl12:file.exampleChinese: 如果希望市政委员会考虑你的请求，就必须在截止日期前提交申请。

ngsl12:middle.exampleEnglish: We stopped in the middle of the bridge to look at the boats passing slowly beneath us.
ngsl12:middle.exampleChinese: 我们停在桥中间，看着船只在脚下缓缓驶过。

ngsl12:bar.exampleEnglish: The rules bar visitors from entering the work area unless a member of staff is accompanying them.
ngsl12:bar.exampleChinese: 规则禁止游客进入作业区，除非有工作人员陪同。

ngsl12:suffer.exampleEnglish: People may suffer from tiredness when their working hours change suddenly and they cannot maintain a regular routine.
ngsl12:suffer.exampleChinese: 工时突然改变、无法保持规律作息时，人们可能会感到疲倦。

ngsl12:strategy.exampleEnglish: Our strategy was to finish the most difficult tasks first, leaving simpler work for the final afternoon.
ngsl12:strategy.exampleChinese: 我们的策略是先完成最难的任务，把较简单的工作留到最后一天下午。

ngsl12:deep.exampleEnglish: The lake is too deep near the old bridge, so swimming is only allowed in the marked area.
ngsl12:deep.exampleChinese: 老桥附近的湖水太深，所以只能在指定区域游泳。

ngsl12:except.exampleEnglish: Everyone except my sister joined the morning walk, because she had already arranged to meet a friend.
ngsl12:except.exampleChinese: 除了我姐姐，所有人都参加了早晨的徒步，因为她已约好去见朋友。

ngsl12:clean.exampleEnglish: The kitchen looked clean when we arrived, but we still washed the surfaces before preparing any food.
ngsl12:clean.exampleChinese: 我们到达时厨房看起来很干净，但准备食物前还是擦洗了台面。

ngsl12:tend.exampleEnglish: Children tend to ask more questions when they can touch the objects being discussed in the lesson.
ngsl12:tend.exampleChinese: 孩子们能触摸课堂上讨论的物品时，往往会提出更多问题。

ngsl12:advance.exampleEnglish: The group could not advance beyond the bridge until the guide had checked that the path was safe.
ngsl12:advance.exampleChinese: 向导确认小路安全之前，这个团队无法继续前进越过桥梁。

ngsl12:fill.exampleEnglish: Please fill the bottle before we leave the campsite, because there may be no water along the route.
ngsl12:fill.exampleChinese: 离开营地前，请把水瓶装满，因为沿途可能没有水。

ngsl12:star.exampleEnglish: The guide pointed out a bright star that sailors once used to help them find their direction.
ngsl12:star.exampleChinese: 导游指给我们看一颗亮星，水手们曾靠它来判断方向。

ngsl12:network.exampleEnglish: The town has a network of paths that connects the school, library and park without crossing busy roads.
ngsl12:network.exampleChinese: 镇上有一套步道网络，连接学校、图书馆和公园，无需穿越繁忙道路。

ngsl12:generally.exampleEnglish: The route is generally quiet in the morning, although it becomes much busier when the weekend market opens.
ngsl12:generally.exampleChinese: 这条路线早晨通常很安静，不过周末市场开门时就热闹得多。

ngsl12:operation.exampleEnglish: The operation of the new heating system is simple once you understand how to set the timer.
ngsl12:operation.exampleChinese: 一旦弄清楚如何设定定时器，这套新供暖系统的操作就很简单。

ngsl12:match.exampleEnglish: The match was delayed by heavy rain, so the players waited inside until the pitch was safe.
ngsl12:match.exampleChinese: 比赛因大雨推迟，所以队员们在室内等待，直到场地恢复安全。

ngsl12:avoid.exampleEnglish: We left the main path to avoid the crowds, but soon discovered that the quieter route was much steeper.
ngsl12:avoid.exampleChinese: 我们离开主路避开人群，却很快发现较安静的路线陡得多。

ngsl12:seat.exampleEnglish: I offered my seat to a passenger who was carrying a baby and several heavy shopping bags.
ngsl12:seat.exampleChinese: 我把座位让给了一位抱着婴儿、提着几个沉重购物袋的乘客。

ngsl12:throw.exampleEnglish: Try to throw the ball gently enough for the younger children to catch it without moving too far.
ngsl12:throw.exampleChinese: 尽量轻轻地扔球，让较小的孩子不用移动太远也能接住。

ngsl12:task.exampleEnglish: The task became easier once we divided it into smaller parts and agreed who would do each one.
ngsl12:task.exampleChinese: 我们把任务拆成小部分，并商定各自负责哪一部分后，任务变容易了。

ngsl12:normal.exampleEnglish: It is normal to feel nervous before speaking to a new group, even if you know the subject well.
ngsl12:normal.exampleChinese: 即使你很熟悉主题，在新群体面前讲话前感到紧张也很正常。

ngsl12:goal.exampleEnglish: Her main goal was to finish the course, but she also hoped to make a few new friends.
ngsl12:goal.exampleChinese: 她的主要目标是完成课程，不过也希望交几个新朋友。

ngsl12:associate.exampleEnglish: Her business associate offered to handle the orders while she travelled abroad to meet a new supplier.
ngsl12:associate.exampleChinese: 她的商业伙伴提出，在她出国会见新供应商期间负责处理订单。

ngsl12:blue.exampleEnglish: The bright blue walls made the room feel cheerful, even when the sky outside was grey.
ngsl12:blue.exampleChinese: 鲜蓝色的墙壁让房间显得很欢快，即使外面的天空灰蒙蒙的。

ngsl12:positive.exampleEnglish: The teacher gave positive feedback that helped the students understand what they had done well in the project.
ngsl12:positive.exampleChinese: 老师给了积极反馈，帮助学生明白自己在项目中哪些方面做得好。

ngsl12:option.exampleEnglish: Taking the train is the cheapest option, although the bus stops much closer to our final destination.
ngsl12:option.exampleChinese: 坐火车是最便宜的选择，不过公交站离我们的最终目的地近得多。

ngsl12:box.exampleEnglish: We put the photographs in a strong box so that they would not get damaged during the move.
ngsl12:box.exampleChinese: 我们把照片放进一个结实的盒子，防止搬家时损坏。

ngsl12:huge.exampleEnglish: The new library has made a huge difference to families who previously had nowhere nearby to borrow books.
ngsl12:huge.exampleChinese: 新图书馆给以前在附近无处借书的家庭带来了巨大改变。

ngsl12:message.exampleEnglish: I left a message explaining where we had gone, in case the others arrived before we returned.
ngsl12:message.exampleChinese: 我留了言，说明我们去了哪里，以防其他人在我们回来前到达。

ngsl12:instance.exampleEnglish: There are several ways to reduce waste; for instance, you can repair things instead of replacing them.
ngsl12:instance.exampleChinese: 减少浪费有几种方法；例如，你可以修理物品，而不是换新的。

ngsl12:style.exampleEnglish: The restaurant's relaxed style makes it popular with families who want a meal without too much formality.
ngsl12:style.exampleChinese: 这家餐馆轻松的风格，让想自在吃顿饭的家庭很喜欢。

ngsl12:refer.exampleEnglish: The article does not refer to any particular school, although its findings may be useful to many teachers.
ngsl12:refer.exampleChinese: 这篇文章没有提到任何特定学校，不过研究结果可能对许多教师有用。

ngsl12:cold.exampleEnglish: The water was too cold for a long swim, so we stayed near the shore and returned quickly.
ngsl12:cold.exampleChinese: 水太冷，不适合长时间游泳，所以我们待在岸边附近，很快就回来了。

ngsl12:push.exampleEnglish: You will need to push the door firmly because the wind is pressing against it from outside.
ngsl12:push.exampleChinese: 你需要用力推门，因为外面的风正顶着门。

ngsl12:quarter.exampleEnglish: Only a quarter of the group had visited the museum before, so the guide began with a general introduction.
ngsl12:quarter.exampleChinese: 团队中只有四分之一的人以前参观过博物馆，所以导游先作了概括介绍。

ngsl12:assume.exampleEnglish: Do not assume that every visitor knows the building, because some people may be coming here for the first time.
ngsl12:assume.exampleChinese: 不要以为每位访客都熟悉这栋楼，因为有些人可能是第一次来。

ngsl12:baby.exampleEnglish: The baby fell asleep during the journey, so we spoke quietly when we finally reached the hotel.
ngsl12:baby.exampleChinese: 婴儿在路上睡着了，所以终于到酒店时，我们说话很轻。

ngsl12:successful.exampleEnglish: The event was successful because local residents helped plan activities that people of different ages could enjoy.
ngsl12:successful.exampleChinese: 这次活动很成功，因为当地居民帮助策划了适合不同年龄人群的活动。

ngsl12:sing.exampleEnglish: The children began to sing as they walked, which made the final part of the journey feel shorter.
ngsl12:sing.exampleChinese: 孩子们边走边唱，让旅程最后一段感觉没那么长了。

ngsl12:doubt.exampleEnglish: There was some doubt about the date, so we checked the invitation before booking our train tickets.
ngsl12:doubt.exampleChinese: 日期有些不确定，所以我们订火车票前核对了邀请函。

ngsl12:competition.exampleEnglish: The competition attracted young designers who were asked to create useful objects from materials that would otherwise be thrown away.
ngsl12:competition.exampleChinese: 这场比赛吸引了年轻设计师，要求他们用原本会被丢弃的材料设计实用物品。

ngsl12:theory.exampleEnglish: The theory seemed convincing, but we needed an experiment to find out whether it matched what actually happened.
ngsl12:theory.exampleChinese: 这个理论似乎很有说服力，但我们需要实验来判断它是否符合实际情况。

ngsl12:propose.exampleEnglish: I propose that we try the new timetable for a month before deciding whether to keep it permanently.
ngsl12:propose.exampleChinese: 我建议先试行新时间表一个月，再决定是否永久保留。

ngsl12:reference.exampleEnglish: Remember to reference the original report whenever you use its figures, so that readers can check the source themselves.
ngsl12:reference.exampleChinese: 使用原报告中的数字时，记得注明出处，方便读者自行核查来源。

ngsl12:argument.exampleEnglish: Their argument about the route ended when they checked the map and discovered that both roads reached the lake.
ngsl12:argument.exampleChinese: 他们查看地图、发现两条路都通往湖泊后，就不再为路线争论了。

ngsl12:adult.exampleEnglish: Every adult accompanying the group received a copy of the plan and a list of emergency contact numbers.
ngsl12:adult.exampleChinese: 每位随团成人都领到了一份计划和紧急联系电话表。

ngsl12:fly.exampleEnglish: The birds fly south when the weather becomes colder, returning only when there is enough food again.
ngsl12:fly.exampleChinese: 天气变冷时，这些鸟飞往南方，直到食物再次充足才会返回。

ngsl12:document.exampleEnglish: Keep a copy of the document somewhere safe, in case the original is lost during the move.
ngsl12:document.exampleChinese: 请把文件副本妥善保存，以防原件在搬家时丢失。

ngsl12:pattern.exampleEnglish: We noticed a pattern in the answers, although we needed more information before we could explain it.
ngsl12:pattern.exampleChinese: 我们在答案中发现了一种规律，不过还需要更多信息才能解释。

ngsl12:application.exampleEnglish: Your application should explain why you want to join the course and what you hope to learn.
ngsl12:application.exampleChinese: 你的申请应说明为什么想参加课程，以及希望学到什么。

ngsl12:hot.exampleEnglish: The classroom became so hot in the afternoon that we moved our discussion to a shaded area outside.
ngsl12:hot.exampleChinese: 下午教室变得很热，于是我们把讨论移到了外面的阴凉处。

ngsl12:obviously.exampleEnglish: The instructions were obviously confusing, because several groups made the same mistake despite reading them carefully twice.
ngsl12:obviously.exampleChinese: 说明显然令人困惑，因为几个小组仔细读了两遍，还是犯了同样的错误。

ngsl12:unclear.exampleEnglish: The reason for the delay remains unclear, although the company has promised to provide more information tomorrow.
ngsl12:unclear.exampleChinese: 延误原因仍不清楚，不过公司承诺明天提供更多信息。

ngsl12:bill.exampleEnglish: We checked the bill carefully because it included a dish that nobody at our table had ordered.
ngsl12:bill.exampleChinese: 我们仔细核对了账单，因为上面有一道我们这一桌无人点过的菜。

ngsl12:search.exampleEnglish: We decided to search the garden first because that was where the children had last seen the kitten.
ngsl12:search.exampleChinese: 我们决定先搜寻花园，因为孩子们最后一次见到小猫就是在那里。

ngsl12:separate.exampleEnglish: Please separate the broken pieces from the rest of the equipment so that nobody uses them by mistake.
ngsl12:separate.exampleChinese: 请把损坏的部件与其他设备分开，免得有人误用。

ngsl12:central.exampleEnglish: The central courtyard provides a quiet place to sit, even though busy classrooms surround it on every side.
ngsl12:central.exampleChinese: 中央庭院四面被忙碌的教室环绕，但仍提供了安静的休息场所。

ngsl12:career.exampleEnglish: She changed her career after discovering that she enjoyed teaching practical skills more than working in an office.
ngsl12:career.exampleChinese: 她发现自己比起办公室工作更喜欢教授实践技能，于是换了职业。

ngsl12:anyway.exampleEnglish: We had almost forgotten about the delayed parcel; anyway, what time are we meeting at the station tomorrow?
ngsl12:anyway.exampleChinese: 我们差不多忘了那个延误的包裹；对了，我们明天几点在车站见面？
