ngsl12:speech.exampleEnglish: She prepared a short speech to thank the volunteers who had worked so hard to restore the garden.
ngsl12:speech.exampleChinese: 她准备了一篇简短讲话，感谢那些为恢复花园而辛勤工作的志愿者。

ngsl12:dog.exampleEnglish: The dog waited by the gate until its owner returned from collecting the children at the nearby school.
ngsl12:dog.exampleChinese: 狗在门边等待，直到主人从附近学校接孩子回来。

ngsl12:officer.exampleEnglish: The safety officer checked the hall before the concert to make sure that all the exits were clear.
ngsl12:officer.exampleChinese: 演唱会前，安全负责人检查了大厅，确保所有出口畅通。

ngsl12:throughout.exampleEnglish: The volunteers remained cheerful throughout the afternoon, even when the rain made their outdoor work more difficult.
ngsl12:throughout.exampleChinese: 整个下午，志愿者们都很愉快，即使下雨让户外工作更困难。

ngsl12:oil.exampleEnglish: The museum explains how oil is taken from deep underground before it is processed into different fuels.
ngsl12:oil.exampleChinese: 博物馆介绍了石油如何从地下深处被开采出来，再加工成不同燃料。

ngsl12:dress.exampleEnglish: She wore a dress that her grandmother had made, adding a jacket when the evening grew cooler.
ngsl12:dress.exampleChinese: 她穿了一条祖母做的连衣裙，傍晚天气转凉时又加了件夹克。

ngsl12:profit.exampleEnglish: Local businesses may profit from the festival because visitors often stay overnight and spend money in nearby shops.
ngsl12:profit.exampleChinese: 当地商家可能从节庆中获利，因为游客往往会留宿，并在附近商店消费。

ngsl12:guess.exampleEnglish: I could only guess how long the journey would take, because I had never used that route before.
ngsl12:guess.exampleChinese: 我只能猜测路程要多久，因为以前从未走过那条路线。

ngsl12:fun.exampleEnglish: The workshop was a fun way to learn about science, especially because we could try the experiments ourselves.
ngsl12:fun.exampleChinese: 工作坊是一种有趣的科学学习方式，尤其是我们可以亲自尝试实验。

ngsl12:protect.exampleEnglish: We planted a row of trees to protect the young vegetables from the strong winds crossing the field.
ngsl12:protect.exampleChinese: 我们种了一排树，保护幼嫩蔬菜免受穿过田野的强风侵袭。

ngsl12:resource.exampleEnglish: The library is a valuable resource for students who need reliable information but cannot afford to buy every book.
ngsl12:resource.exampleChinese: 对于需要可靠信息却买不起所有书籍的学生来说，图书馆是一项宝贵资源。

ngsl12:science.exampleEnglish: Her interest in science grew when she began asking why the plants in different parts of the garden grew differently.
ngsl12:science.exampleChinese: 她开始追问为什么花园不同位置的植物生长不同后，对科学的兴趣增加了。

ngsl12:disease.exampleEnglish: Scientists study how the disease spreads between plants so that farmers can protect the rest of their crops.
ngsl12:disease.exampleChinese: 科学家研究这种疾病如何在植物间传播，以帮助农民保护其余作物。

ngsl12:balance.exampleEnglish: She tries to balance work and family life by keeping her evenings free whenever the schedule allows.
ngsl12:balance.exampleChinese: 只要日程允许，她就尽量腾出晚间时间，以平衡工作与家庭生活。

ngsl12:damage.exampleEnglish: The storm caused considerable damage to the roof, although the rooms below remained dry throughout the night.
ngsl12:damage.exampleChinese: 暴风雨对屋顶造成了严重破坏，不过下面的房间整夜仍然干燥。

ngsl12:basis.exampleEnglish: The survey provides a useful basis for discussion, but we should hear residents' views before making a decision.
ngsl12:basis.exampleChinese: 调查为讨论提供了有用基础，但我们在决定前应听取居民意见。

ngsl12:author.exampleEnglish: The author visited our school to explain how a childhood memory had inspired her most recent story.
ngsl12:author.exampleChinese: 作者来到我们学校，解释一段童年记忆如何启发了她最新的故事。

ngsl12:basic.exampleEnglish: The course covers basic skills such as measuring and cutting, before moving on to more complicated projects.
ngsl12:basic.exampleChinese: 课程先介绍测量、切割等基本技能，然后进入更复杂的项目。

ngsl12:encourage.exampleEnglish: The club hopes to encourage more families to cycle by showing them safer routes around the town.
ngsl12:encourage.exampleChinese: 俱乐部希望通过介绍镇上更安全的路线，鼓励更多家庭骑车。

ngsl12:hair.exampleEnglish: She tied her hair back before starting the experiment, as the safety instructions required everyone to do.
ngsl12:hair.exampleChinese: 她开始实验前把头发扎到后面，安全说明要求所有人都这样做。

ngsl12:male.exampleEnglish: The wildlife guide explained how male birds sometimes use bright feathers to attract attention during spring.
ngsl12:male.exampleChinese: 野生动物向导解释了雄鸟有时如何在春天用鲜艳羽毛吸引注意。

ngsl12:operate.exampleEnglish: Only trained staff can operate the machine because its moving parts could be dangerous if used incorrectly.
ngsl12:operate.exampleChinese: 只有受过培训的员工才能操作这台机器，因为使用不当时其活动部件可能危险。

ngsl12:reflect.exampleEnglish: The large windows reflect the afternoon sunlight, making the building appear brighter when viewed from across the river.
ngsl12:reflect.exampleChinese: 大窗户反射午后的阳光，从河对岸看时，大楼显得更明亮。

ngsl12:exercise.exampleEnglish: Regular exercise became easier to maintain once she found a walking group that met near her home.
ngsl12:exercise.exampleChinese: 找到一个在家附近集合的步行小组后，她更容易坚持定期锻炼了。

ngsl12:useful.exampleEnglish: The map proved useful when our phones lost signal and we needed to find another route home.
ngsl12:useful.exampleChinese: 手机没有信号、我们需要寻找其他回家路线时，这张地图派上了用场。

ngsl12:restaurant.exampleEnglish: We chose a restaurant that served local dishes, although we had to wait until a table became available.
ngsl12:restaurant.exampleChinese: 我们选了一家供应当地菜的餐馆，不过不得不等到有空桌。

ngsl12:income.exampleEnglish: Their income changes from month to month because both parents work on projects rather than receiving fixed salaries.
ngsl12:income.exampleChinese: 他们家的收入每月不同，因为父母双方都按项目工作，而不是领固定工资。

ngsl12:property.exampleEnglish: The property includes a small garden, which the previous owner used to grow vegetables for the family.
ngsl12:property.exampleChinese: 这处房产包括一个小花园，前任屋主曾用它为家人种蔬菜。

ngsl12:previous.exampleEnglish: My previous job involved travelling frequently, whereas my current role allows me to work much closer to home.
ngsl12:previous.exampleChinese: 我上一份工作需要经常出差，而现在的职位让我能在离家近得多的地方工作。

ngsl12:dark.exampleEnglish: The room became too dark to read comfortably, so I moved my chair closer to the window.
ngsl12:dark.exampleChinese: 房间变得太暗，无法舒服地阅读，所以我把椅子挪到了窗边。

ngsl12:imagine.exampleEnglish: Try to imagine how the village looked before the bridge was built and most visitors arrived by boat.
ngsl12:imagine.exampleChinese: 试着想象建桥以前村庄的样子，那时多数访客乘船到来。

ngsl12:okay.exampleEnglish: Okay, we can change the meeting time, provided everyone receives the new details before they leave home.
ngsl12:okay.exampleChinese: 好的，我们可以改会议时间，前提是所有人在离家前都收到新安排。

ngsl12:earn.exampleEnglish: She began to earn extra money by repairing clothes for neighbours after finishing her evening sewing course.
ngsl12:earn.exampleChinese: 完成晚间缝纫课程后，她开始为邻居修补衣服，赚取额外收入。

ngsl12:daughter.exampleEnglish: Their daughter chose to volunteer at the museum because she wanted to learn more about local history.
ngsl12:daughter.exampleChinese: 他们的女儿选择在博物馆做志愿者，因为她想更多地了解当地历史。

ngsl12:post.exampleEnglish: I will post the signed form tomorrow, so it should reach your office before the closing date.
ngsl12:post.exampleChinese: 我明天把签好的表格寄出，应该能在截止日期前送到你的办公室。

ngsl12:newspaper.exampleEnglish: The local newspaper published an article about the volunteers who had restored the old path beside the river.
ngsl12:newspaper.exampleChinese: 当地报纸刊登了一篇文章，介绍那些修复河边旧小路的志愿者。

ngsl12:define.exampleEnglish: Before we begin the discussion, we should define the key terms so that everyone understands them in the same way.
ngsl12:define.exampleChinese: 讨论开始前，我们应该定义关键术语，让所有人的理解保持一致。

ngsl12:conclusion.exampleEnglish: We reached the same conclusion after comparing the results, although we had used different methods to collect the information.
ngsl12:conclusion.exampleChinese: 比较结果后，我们得出了相同的结论，尽管收集信息的方法不同。

ngsl12:clock.exampleEnglish: The clock above the entrance had stopped, so nobody noticed how late it was until the caretaker arrived.
ngsl12:clock.exampleChinese: 入口上方的钟停了，所以直到管理员到来，才有人注意到已经这么晚了。

ngsl12:everybody.exampleEnglish: Everybody brought something for the picnic, which meant we had far more food than we could finish.
ngsl12:everybody.exampleChinese: 每个人都带了些野餐食物，结果食物远远多得吃不完。

ngsl12:weekend.exampleEnglish: We spent the weekend repairing the garden fence, taking breaks whenever the rain became too heavy to continue.
ngsl12:weekend.exampleChinese: 我们整个周末都在修花园围栏，每当雨大到无法继续时就休息。

ngsl12:perform.exampleEnglish: The students will perform a short experiment to show how different materials react when they are heated.
ngsl12:perform.exampleChinese: 学生们将做一个简短实验，展示不同材料受热时如何反应。

ngsl12:professional.exampleEnglish: She sought professional advice before signing the contract because some of its conditions were difficult to understand.
ngsl12:professional.exampleChinese: 签合同前，她寻求了专业意见，因为其中有些条款难以理解。

ngsl12:mine.exampleEnglish: The notebook beside your bag is mine, but you are welcome to use it if you need paper.
ngsl12:mine.exampleChinese: 你包旁边的笔记本是我的，不过需要纸时你可以用。

ngsl12:debate.exampleEnglish: The debate about the new sports centre continued for weeks, with residents expressing different views about its location.
ngsl12:debate.exampleChinese: 关于新体育中心的辩论持续了数周，居民对选址表达了不同观点。
